################################################################################
# 6. REPORTING & AUTOMATION  (the output layer)
################################################################################

Two automated daily emails. Both: scope = CIRCLE JAVA (Central + East Java /
provinces JATENG, JATIM, DIY, BALI); recipients = users with email_recipient=1
AND is_active=1 AND email set; single message to ALL recipients (each as a To);
kill-switch tbl_ftth_setting.email_blast_enabled (0 = run but don't send);
subject/filenames use DATA date not run date.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
6.1 REPORT A — "FTTH MTD Sales Performance" (06:00)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Subject: FTTH MTD Sales Performance — Circle JAVA · {data date}
  Built from ftth_raw_joined / ftth_mtd_tracker_daily.
  Three sections, each = KPI hero cards (SO/SA/PA + Ach%) + a 2-row-header
  tracker table:
    Section 01 Sales Force  : Region -> SM (WITH TARGET cols)
    Section 02 Product Mix  : Regular vs AP buckets (no target)
    Section 03 Geography    : Province -> Kab/Kota (no target)
  Table column groups: MTD SO | MTD SA | MTD PA [| TARGET], each with sub-cols
    LLMTD (prev2) · LMTD (prev1) · MTD (curr) · Growth ; target sub-cols
    Tgt · Ach · Ach% · GAP. Hierarchy rows: Region -> SM -> Region Total ->
    CIRCLE JAVA TOTAL. Traffic-light Ach (<80 red,<95 amber,>=95 green).
  Attachments:
    - XLSX (5 sheets): 01 SM x Region, 02 Regular AP, 03 Province Kabkota,
      04 Detail Territory, 05 Detail Sales.
    - 6 PDFs: 1 Circle comprehensive + 5 per-SM (one per non-vacant SM).

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
6.2 REPORT B — "FTTH Subs & Net Add - Circle Java" (06:30)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Subject: FTTH Subs & Net Add - Circle Java - {Mon YYYY}
  Built from db_ftth_sitewise_monthly (DIFFERENT source/grain — monthly snapshot).
  Metric semantics: pa_c = PA snapshot current; pa_lytd = PA same-month-last-year;
    Net Add YoY = pa_c - pa_lytd (snapshot delta, NOT sum of monthly net adds);
    net_add_curr = SUM(pa_net_latest) current month; net_add_ytd = SUM Jan..cur;
    TUR% = pa_c/homepass*100.
  Sections (Circle->Region->Kab/Kota): A Geography rollup; B Project Group
    (with Share% of subs); C Top 15 / D Bottom 15 kecamatan by net add;
    E All kecamatan (Excel only).
  Region codes normalized by NAME to collapse old/new codes (avoid double count).
  Attachment: XLSX (5 sheets). No PDF.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
6.3 PDF REPORTS  (Python 3 + ReportLab; presentation over the report JSON)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Type 1 — Circle comprehensive: filename YYYYMMDD_FTTH_CIRCLE_JAVA.pdf
    Cover -> KPI hero (SO/SA/PA MTD + growth) -> Daily Insight ->
    01 Sales Force (SM x Region w/ target) -> 02 Product Mix (AP/Regular) ->
    03 Product (top products) -> 04 Geography (Province/Kabkota).
  Type 2 — Per-SM (one per real SM): filename YYYYMMDD_SM_{NAME}.pdf
    Cover -> KPI (+ Achievement if target) -> Daily Insight (SM-scoped) ->
    01 Sales Manager summary -> 02 Team Leaders breakdown (the headline:
    per-TL LLMTD/LMTD/MTD/Growth for SO/SA/PA) -> 03 Product Mix -> 04 Product ->
    05 Geography -> 06 Top 10 Sales persons (MTD: SO/SA/PA, SO->SA%, SO->PA%,
    Avg Rev/PA).
  All numeric tables use the LLMTD/LMTD/MTD/Growth trended trio.

  "DAILY INSIGHT" (AI narrative, optional):
    Calls a local LLM (OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat/completions) to write a short
    Indonesian executive insight that dissects each parameter (SO/SA/PA growth,
    drivers of decline, top & bottom performers). Achievement always measured on
    PA. Has a deterministic RULE-BASED FALLBACK (top/bottom by PA, SO->PA
    conversion, avg achievement) so the report never fails if the LLM is down.
  [BQ/replatform] Treat PDFs/Excel/insight as a presentation layer over a single
    REPORT JSON contract: { meta, sm/ap/province circles[], product_trio[],
    tl_by_sm{}, *_trio_by_sm{}, raw_detail[] }. Mobile/web can render the same
    JSON natively; PDF/Excel/LLM-insight are export enrichments.


################################################################################
# 7. AUTH, ROLES, SECURITY, SETTINGS  (platform layer)
################################################################################

ROLES & PERMISSIONS (tbl_ftth_user.hak_akses):
  Administrator : all permissions (*)
  Operator      : view_all_analytics, export, edit_data
  Analyst       : view_all_analytics, export
  Viewer        : view_basic
  Admin-only modules: user_management, email_recipients, access_stats, settings.

AUTH FLOW:
  login -> bcrypt verify -> on success regenerate session, set keys
    {id_user, nama_user, username, hak_akses, logged_in, login_time,
     last_activity, must_change_password}.
  Lockout: failed_attempts increments; at lockout_threshold (default 5) set
    locked_until = now + lockout_duration_minutes (default 15).
  Every request gated centrally: not-logged-in redirect; idle timeout
    (session_timeout_minutes, default 60); force-logout (force_logout_at >
    login_time) & is_active=0; must-change-password redirect; maintenance mode
    (non-admin blocked); CSRF token on non-GET AJAX.

ACCESS LOG (tbl_ftth_access_log): append-only; action_type in {login_success,
  login_failed, logout, module_view, export, create, update, delete,
  password_change}; fields user_id, username, action_type, module, target,
  ip_address, user_agent, session_id(hashed), detail(JSON), created_at.
  IP order: CF-Connecting-IP -> X-Forwarded-For -> X-Real-IP -> REMOTE_ADDR.
  Retention: prune older than log_retention_days (Sun 04:00).
  [BQ] partition by DATE(created_at).

SETTINGS (tbl_ftth_setting key/value): app branding/logo, password rules,
  lockout_threshold/duration, session_timeout_minutes, working_hours_start/end
  (off-hours detection), email_blast_enabled (email kill-switch),
  maintenance_mode/message, log_retention_days, welcome_* popup.

KEY REFERENCE/CONFIG TABLES (db_ftth_app):

  tbl_ftth_target_sm       per-SM monthly PA targets

  raw (landing, partitioned):

  core (modeled):
    fact_funnel       = ftth_raw_joined equivalent: 1 row/bill_acc, has_sa/has_pa,
                        status, days_so_sa, days_so_pa, sales hierarchy + circle

    dim_region        = region_head (sales_region -> circle, head, order).

    fact_market_share = weekly per-kabkota long-format (unpivot the wide
                        operator columns into rows: operator, ga, churn, total)
                        joined to dim_territory(kabkota->region->circle).
    fact_access_log   = activity log (partition by created_at).
    cfg_target_sm, cfg_cost, cfg_setting, dim_user.

8.2 SEMANTIC LAYER (implement once, reuse on mobile+web)
  - Funnel metrics (multi-date counting + MTD cutoff) as parameterized SQL /
    views / a metrics layer (e.g. dbt metrics, Looker, or an API).
  - Shared UDFs: growth%, ap_classify(product), project_group(site_project_awal),
    tur_slab(tur), circle_from_region(name), province_to_circle(province).
  - MTD cutoff = a single scalar (max data day) applied uniformly to compared

8.3 API CONTRACT (mobile + web share these endpoints; mirror current data.php)
  GET /filters?...                 -> cascading filter options (cross-filter)

8.5 NON-NEGOTIABLE BEHAVIORS TO PRESERVE (or numbers won't match)
  1. Multi-date counting (SO on date_so, SA on date_sa where has_sa,
     PA on date_pa where has_pa).
  2. MTD cutoff = max data day, applied to current AND comparison months.

Sesuai instruksi dari KNOWLEDGE BASE: 
"THE THREE FUNNEL STAGES (the heart of everything):
  SO = Service Order      (a customer ordered FTTH; counted on date_so)
  SA = Service Active     (service was activated; counted on date_sa)
  PA = Permanent Active   (became a permanent/billing subscriber; on date_pa)
  Funnel: SO -> SA -> PA. PA is the money/revenue event."

"EVERY funnel metric in the app is computed from this table as:
    SO  = COUNT(*) where date_so in window
    SA  = COUNTIF(has_sa=1 AND date_sa in window)
    PA  = COUNTIF(has_pa=1 AND date_pa in window)
    Revenue(SO) = SUM(price) over SO-window rows
    Revenue(PA) = SUM(IF(has_pa AND date_pa in window, price, 0))"

Determine dates\n    try:\n        if month_id:\n            year, mo = str(month_id)[:4], str(month_id)[4:6]\n            import calendar\n            last_day = datetime.date(int(year), int(mo), calendar.monthrange(int(year), int(mo))[1])\n            max_dt = last_day.isoformat()\n        else:\n            mx_res = run_query(f\"SELECT MAX(date_so) as m FROM {_SO}\")\n            max_dt = mx_res[\"rows\"][0][\"m\"]\n            \n        dt = datetime.datetime.strptime(max_dt, \"%Y-%m-%d\").date()\n        cutoff_day = dt.day\n        \n        cur_start = dt.replace(day=1).isoformat()\n        lmtd_dt = (dt.replace(day=1) - datetime.timedelta(days=1)).isoformat()\n        lmtd_start = (datetime.datetime.strptime(lmtd_dt, \"%Y-%m-%d\").replace(day=1)).isoformat()\n        \n        llmtd_dt = (datetime.datetime.strptime(lmtd_start, \"%Y-%m-%d\").replace(day=1) - datetime.timedelta(days=1)).isoformat()\n        llmtd_start = (datetime.datetime.strptime(llmtd_dt, \"%Y-%m-%d\").replace(day=1)).isoformat()\n        \n    except Exception:\n        return {\"error\": \"Failed to determine max date for FTTH.\"}\n\n    # 2. Extract Funnel Data\n    so_data = _build_funnel_sql(_SO, \"date_so\", max_dt, lmtd_dt, llmtd_dt, cur_start, lmtd_start, llmtd_start, cutoff_day, circle, filter_type, filter_value)\n    sa_data = _build_funnel_sql(_SA, \"date_sa\", max_dt, lmtd_dt, llmtd_dt, cur_start, lmtd_start, llmtd_start, cutoff_day, circle, filter_type, filter_value)\n    pa_data = _build_funnel_sql(_PA, \"date_pa\", max_dt, lmtd_dt, llmtd_dt, cur_start, lmtd_start, llmtd_start, cutoff_day, circle, filter_type, filter_value)\n\n    # 3. Extract Sitewise / TUR Data\n    # sitewise_monthly is partitioned by month_id (string YYYYMM)\n    cur_mth = dt.strftime(\"%Y%m\")\n    lmtd_mth = datetime.datetime.strptime(lmtd_dt, \"%Y-%m-%d\").strftime(\"%Y%m\")\n    llmtd_mth = datetime.datetime.strptime(llmtd_dt, \"%Y-%m-%d\").strftime(\"%Y%m\")\n    \n    sw_provs = _circle_provinces(circle)\n    sw_prov_filter = \"1=1\" if circle.upper() == \"ALL\" else (\"UPPER(f.provinsi) IN (\" + \",\".join(f\"'{p}'\" for p in sw_provs) + \")\")\n    \n    sw_join = \"\"\n    sw_tf = \"\"\n    if filter_type and filter_value and filter_type != \"all\":\n        sw_join = f\" LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT kecamatan, kabkot, branch_im3, area_im3, region, micro_cluster_im3 FROM {_TERR}) t ON UPPER(f.kecamatan) = UPPER(t.kecamatan) \"\n        sw_tf = _terr_filter(filter_type, filter_value, \"t\")\n        \n    sw_sql = f\"\"\"\nSELECT \n  f.month_id,\n  SUM(homepass) as hp,\n  SUM(pa) as pa_cum,\n  SUM(pa_net_latest) as net_add,\n  SUM(ga) as ga,\n  SUM(available_hp) as avail_hp\nFROM {_SITEWISE} f\n{sw_join}\nWHERE {sw_prov_filter} {sw_tf}\n  AND month_id IN ('{cur_mth}', '{lmtd_mth}', '{llmtd_mth}')\nGROUP BY month_id\n\"\"\"\n    try:\n        sw_rows = run_query(sw_sql)[\"rows\"]\n    except Exception:\n        sw_rows = []\n        \n    sw_map = {r[\"month_id\"]: r for r in sw_rows}\n    def get_sw(mth, col): return float(sw_map.get(mth, {}).get(col, 0) or 0)\n    \n    # 4. Format into ComprehensiveView structure\n    # FTTH doesn't have IM3/3ID split, everything is HiFi. We'll put it all in \"ioh\".\n    def create_metric(code, name, unit, mtd_val, lmtd_val, llmtd_val, ytd_val=None, lytd_val=None):\n        def safe_growth(cur, prev):\n            if cur is None or prev is None or prev == 0: return None\n            return (cur - prev) / abs(prev) * 100\n            \n        m = {\n            \"code\": code,\n            \"name\": name,\n            \"unit\": unit,\n            \"network\": False,\n            \"snapshot\": False,\n            \"computed\": False,\n            \"ioh\": {\n                \"mtd\": mtd_val, \"lmtd\": lmtd_val, \"llmtd\": llmtd_val,\n                \"var_mom\": (mtd_val - lmtd_val) if (mtd_val is not None and lmtd_val is not None) else None,\n                \"growth_mom_pct\": safe_growth(mtd_val, lmtd_val),\n                \"ytd\": ytd_val, \"lytd\": lytd_val,\n                \"var_yoy\": (ytd_val - lytd_val) if (ytd_val is not None and lytd_val is not None) else None,\n                \"growth_yoy_pct\": safe_growth(ytd_val, lytd_val)\n            }\n        }\n        # Fake IM3/3ID blocks so frontend doesn't crash, but FTTH is a unified brand.\n        # The frontend will just hide them if we only look at IOH, or we can just zero them out.\n        m[\"im3\"] = {k:None for k in m[\"ioh\"]}\n        m[\"3id\"] = {k:None for k in m[\"ioh\"]}\n        return m\n\n    def calc_ratio(n_mtd, d_mtd, n_lmtd, d_lmtd, n_llmtd, d_llmtd):\n        return (\n            (n_mtd/d_mtd*100) if d_mtd else None,\n            (n_lmtd/d_lmtd*100) if d_lmtd else None,\n            (n_llmtd/d_llmtd*100) if d_llmtd else None\n        )\n\n    sections = []\n    \n    # Section 1: Sales Funnel (Flow Metrics -> YTD is Sum)\n    so_sa_mtd, so_sa_lmtd, so_sa_llmtd = calc_ratio(sa_data[\"cnt_mtd\"], so_data[\"cnt_mtd\"], sa_data[\"cnt_lmtd\"], so_data[\"cnt_lmtd\"], sa_data[\"cnt_llmtd\"], so_data[\"cnt_llmtd\"])\n    sa_pa_mtd, sa_pa_lmtd, sa_pa_llmtd = calc_ratio(pa_data[\"cnt_mtd\"], sa_data[\"cnt_mtd\"], pa_data[\"cnt_lmtd\"], sa_data[\"cnt_lmtd\"], pa_data[\"cnt_llmtd\"], sa_data[\"cnt_llmtd\"])\n    so_pa_mtd, so_pa_lmtd, so_pa_llmtd = calc_ratio(pa_data[\"cnt_mtd\"], so_data[\"cnt_mtd\"], pa_data[\"cnt_lmtd\"], so_data[\"cnt_lmtd\"], pa_data[\"cnt_llmtd\"], so_data[\"cnt_llmtd\"])\n    \n    sections.append({\n        \"title\": \"Sales Funnel (Indosat HiFi)\",\n        \"group\": \"FTTH Performance\",\n        \"layout\": \"grid\",\n        \"cumulative_yoy\": True,\n        \"metrics\": [\n            create_metric(\"ftth_so\", \"Service Order (SO)\", \"Orders\", so_data[\"cnt_mtd\"], so_data[\"cnt_lmtd\"], so_data[\"cnt_llmtd\"], so_data[\"cnt_ytd\"], so_data[\"cnt_lytd\"]),\n            create_metric(\"ftth_sa\", \"Service Active (SA)\", \"Orders\", sa_data[\"cnt_mtd\"], sa_data[\"cnt_lmtd\"], sa_data[\"cnt_llmtd\"], sa_data[\"cnt_ytd\"], sa_data[\"cnt_lytd\"]),\n            create_metric(\"ftth_pa\", \"Permanent Active (PA)\", \"Orders\", pa_data[\"cnt_mtd\"], pa_data[\"cnt_lmtd\"], pa_data[\"cnt_llmtd\"], pa_data[\"cnt_ytd\"], pa_data[\"cnt_lytd\"]),\n            create_metric(\"ftth_rev\", \"PA Revenue\", \"IDR\", pa_data[\"rev_mtd\"], pa_data[\"rev_lmtd\"], pa_data[\"rev_llmtd\"], pa_data[\"rev_ytd\"], pa_data[\"rev_lytd\"]),\n            create_metric(\"ftth_conv_sosa\", \"Conversion SO -> SA\", \"%\", so_sa_mtd, so_sa_lmtd, so_sa_llmtd),\n            create_metric(\"ftth_conv_sapa\", \"Conversion SA -> PA\", \"%\", sa_pa_mtd, sa_pa_lmtd, sa_pa_llmtd),\n            create_metric(\"ftth_conv_sopa\", \"Conversion SO -> PA\", \"%\", so_pa_mtd, so_pa_lmtd, so_pa_llmtd),\n        ]\n    })\n    \n    # For computed ratios in UI, mark them computed so they render properly\n    for i in range(4, 7): sections[0][\"metrics\"][i][\"computed\"] = True\n\n    # Section 2: Territory / TUR (Snapshot Metrics -> YTD is Point in time)\n    # ytd = current mtd, lytd = point in time last year (we skip lytd for now as it needs a 1-year ago query for sitewise)\n    \n    # Compute TUR and Extraction\n    hp_mtd = get_sw(cur_mth, \"hp\"); hp_lmtd = get_sw(lmtd_mth, \"hp\"); hp_llmtd = get_sw(llmtd_mth, \"hp\")\n    pa_cum_mtd = get_sw(cur_mth, \"pa_cum\"); pa_cum_lmtd = get_sw(lmtd_mth, \"pa_cum\"); pa_cum_llmtd = get_sw(llmtd_mth, \"pa_cum\")\n    avail_mtd = get_sw(cur_mth, \"avail_hp\"); avail_lmtd = get_sw(lmtd_mth, \"avail_hp\"); avail_llmtd = get_sw(llmtd_mth, \"avail_hp\")\n    ga_sw_mtd = get_sw(cur_mth, \"ga\"); ga_sw_lmtd = get_sw(lmtd_mth, \"ga\"); ga_sw_llmtd = get_sw(llmtd_mth, \"ga\")\n    \n    tur_mtd, tur_lmtd, tur_llmtd = calc_ratio(pa_cum_mtd, hp_mtd, pa_cum_lmtd, hp_lmtd, pa_cum_llmtd, hp_llmtd)\n    ext_mtd, ext_lmtd, ext_llmtd = calc_ratio(ga_sw_mtd, avail_mtd, ga_sw_lmtd, avail_lmtd, ga_sw_llmtd, avail_llmtd)\n\n    sections.append({\n        \"title\": \"Territory Capacity & TUR\",\n        \"layout\": \"grid\",\n        \"cumulative_yoy\": True, # So it displays YTD col\n        \"metrics\": [\n            create_metric(\"ftth_hp\", \"Total Homepass\", \"Homes\", hp_mtd, hp_lmtd, hp_llmtd, hp_mtd, None),\n            create_metric(\"ftth_avail\", \"Available Homepass\", \"Homes\", avail_mtd, avail_lmtd, avail_llmtd, avail_mtd, None),\n            create_metric(\"ftth_pa_cum\", \"Total Active Subs\", \"Subs\", pa_cum_mtd, pa_cum_lmtd, pa_cum_llmtd, pa_cum_mtd, None),\n            create_metric(\"ftth_netadd\", \"Net Add\", \"Subs\", get_sw(cur_mth, \"net_add\"), get_sw(lmtd_mth, \"net_add\"), get_sw(llmtd_mth, \"net_add\"), get_sw(cur_mth, \"net_add\"), None),\n            create_metric(\"ftth_ga\", \"Gross Add (Site)\", \"Subs\", ga_sw_mtd, ga_sw_lmtd, ga_sw_llmtd, ga_sw_mtd, None),\n            create_metric(\"ftth_tur\", \"Take-Up Rate (TUR)\", \"%\", tur_mtd, tur_lmtd, tur_llmtd, tur_mtd, None),\n            create_metric(\"ftth_ext\", \"Extraction Rate\", \"%\", ext_mtd, ext_lmtd, ext_llmtd, ext_mtd, None),\n        ]\n    })\n    \n    for i in range(5, 7): sections[1][\"metrics\"][i][\"computed\"] = True\n    for i in range(0, 5): sections[1][\"metrics\"][i][\"snapshot\"] = True\n\n    return {\n        \"scope\": {\"circle\": circle, \"filter_type\": filter_type, \"filter_value\": filter_value, \"data_as_of\": max_dt, \"month_id\": cur_mth},\n        \"sections\": sections\n    }\n"
}

def build_ftth(circle: str, filter_type: str = "all", filter_value: str = "", month_id: Optional[int] = None) -> dict:
    # 1. Determine dates
    try:
        if month_id:
            year, mo = str(month_id)[:4], str(month_id)[4:6]
            import calendar
            last_day = datetime.date(int(year), int(mo), calendar.monthrange(int(year), int(mo))[1])
            max_dt = last_day.isoformat()
        else:
            mx_res = run_query(f"SELECT MAX(date_so) as m FROM {_SO}")
            max_dt = mx_res["rows"][0]["m"]
            
        dt = datetime.datetime.strptime(max_dt, "%Y-%m-%d").date()
        cutoff_day = dt.day
        
        cur_start = dt.replace(day=1).isoformat()
        lmtd_dt = (dt.replace(day=1) - datetime.timedelta(days=1)).isoformat()
        lmtd_start = (datetime.datetime.strptime(lmtd_dt, "%Y-%m-%d").replace(day=1)).isoformat()
        
        llmtd_dt = (datetime.datetime.strptime(lmtd_start, "%Y-%m-%d").replace(day=1) - datetime.timedelta(days=1)).isoformat()
        llmtd_start = (datetime.datetime.strptime(llmtd_dt, "%Y-%m-%d").replace(day=1)).isoformat()
        
    except Exception:
        return {"error": "Failed to determine max date for FTTH."}

File ini memuat struktur skema data di BigQuery, aturan pemetaan filter *Circle-Sales_Region*, arsitektur Caching, tata letak *UI Component* di React dan Flutter, dan seluruh parameter metrik agar jika Anda ingin membangkitkan proyek di kemudian hari menggunakan *Claude* / AI lain, struktur aplikasinya bisa dibangun replikanya dengan *100% pixel-perfect* serta bebas cacat matematika. 

## Penambahan Laporan FTTH Indosat HiFi
Sistem ini mengambil dua sudut pandang berbeda yang mematuhi hukum agregat data sesuai spesifikasi:
1. **Sales Funnel Domain (Transaksi):** Menampilkan pergerakan dan volume transaksi untuk `Service Order (SO)`, `Service Active (SA)`, dan `Permanent Active (PA)`, beserta nilai `Revenue PA` bulanan dan `Conversion Rate (SO->SA, SA->PA, SO->PA)`. Angkanya didapatkan dari komputasi batas cut-off (tanggal mentah di tabel transaksi) dibandingkan secara setara (YTD dan LMTD/LLMTD) sehingga tidak ada hitungan asimetris antara bulan yang berjalan dan bulan sebelumnya.
2. **Territory Capacity & TUR (Sitewise Domain):** Menganalisis utilisasi homepass per wilayah dengan poin pengukuran: `Total Homepass`, `Available Homepass`, `Total Active Subs`, `Net Add`, `Gross Add`, beserta % persentase utilitasnya (`Take-Up Rate` dan `Extraction Rate`). Nilai YTD-nya diproyeksikan sebagai nilai *snapshot* / titik-waktu (`Point in Time`).

### Tampilan Web & App Mobile (v1.42.0+47)
- FTTH telah mendapat slot tersendiri di dalam *sub-tab* **Performance Outlook** (ditempatkan di samping `Daily Snapshot`, `Comprehensive`, dll). 
- Di *My Coordinate* (GPS auto-lock) maupun *Territory Wise* (Manual Filter Area), seluruh metrik ini dapat langsung di-*slice and dice* hingga level kecamatan/micro-cluster (via Dropdown).
- Data dapat memuat instan berkat mekanisme pemanasan singgahan di latar belakang (Background Prefetching) dan Anda bisa me-*refresh* ke pembaruan data terbaru (Data As Of `[tanggal]`) tanpa *lag*.

Anda bisa mengetuk tab `Indosat HiFi (FTTH)` yang kini telah tersedia baik di versi Desktop Web maupun Mobile App terbaru untuk melihat data aslinya.

from __future__ import annotations

def _esc(v: str) -> str:
    return (v or "").replace("'", "")

def _circle_provinces(circle: str) -> list[str]:
    c = (circle or "").upper()
    if c == "JAVA":
        return ["JAWA TENGAH", "JAWA TIMUR", "DAERAH ISTIMEWA YOGYAKARTA", "BALI", "YOGYAKARTA"]
    elif c == "JAYA":
        return ["JAWA BARAT", "DKI JAKARTA", "BANTEN"]
    elif c == "SUMATERA":
        return ["ACEH", "BENGKULU", "JAMBI", "LAMPUNG", "RIAU", "KEPULAUAN RIAU", "KEPULAUAN BANGKA BELITUNG", "SUMATERA SELATAN", "SUMATERA UTARA", "SUMATERA BARAT"]
    return []

def _terr_filter(filter_type: str, filter_value: str, prefix: str = "t") -> str:
    if not filter_value:
        return ""
    col = {"region": "region", "area": "area_im3", "branch": "branch_im3",
           "kabkota": "kabkot", "kecamatan": "kec_id",
           "microcluster": "micro_cluster_im3"}.get(filter_type)
    if filter_type == 'kabkota':
        pass
    return f" AND {prefix}.{col} = '{_esc(filter_value)}'" if col else ""

def _build_funnel_sql(table: str, date_col: str, cur_dt: str, lmtd_dt: str, llmtd_dt: str, 
                     cur_start: str, lmtd_start: str, llmtd_start: str, cutoff_day: int, circle: str, 
                     filter_type: str, filter_value: str) -> dict:
    provs = _circle_provinces(circle)
    prov_filter = "1=1" if circle.upper() == "ALL" else ("UPPER(f.province) IN (" + ",".join(f"'{p}'" for p in provs) + ")")

        tf = _terr_filter(filter_type, filter_value, "t")

    sql = f"""
SELECT 
  COUNTIF({date_col} >= '{cur_start}' AND {date_col} <= '{cur_dt}') as cnt_mtd,

  COUNTIF({date_col} >= '{lmtd_start}' AND {date_col} <= '{lmtd_dt}' AND EXTRACT(DAY FROM {date_col}) <= {cutoff_day}) as cnt_lmtd,
  SUM(IF({date_col} >= '{lmtd_start}' AND {date_col} <= '{lmtd_dt}' AND EXTRACT(DAY FROM {date_col}) <= {cutoff_day}, price, 0)) as rev_lmtd,
  
  COUNTIF({date_col} >= '{llmtd_start}' AND {date_col} <= '{llmtd_dt}' AND EXTRACT(DAY FROM {date_col}) <= {cutoff_day}) as cnt_llmtd,
  SUM(IF({date_col} >= '{llmtd_start}' AND {date_col} <= '{llmtd_dt}' AND EXTRACT(DAY FROM {date_col}) <= {cutoff_day}, price, 0)) as rev_llmtd,
  
  COUNTIF({date_col} >= '{cur_start[:4]}-01-01' AND {date_col} <= '{cur_dt}') as cnt_ytd,
  SUM(IF({date_col} >= '{cur_start[:4]}-01-01' AND {date_col} <= '{cur_dt}', price, 0)) as rev_ytd,
  
  COUNTIF({date_col} >= '{lmtd_start[:4]}-01-01' AND {date_col} <= '{cur_dt[:4]}-12-31' AND {date_col} <= DATE_SUB('{cur_dt}', INTERVAL 1 YEAR)) as cnt_lytd,
  SUM(IF({date_col} >= '{lmtd_start[:4]}-01-01' AND {date_col} <= '{cur_dt[:4]}-12-31' AND {date_col} <= DATE_SUB('{cur_dt}', INTERVAL 1 YEAR), price, 0)) as rev_lytd
  
FROM {table} f
{join_terr}
WHERE {prov_filter} {tf}
"""
    try:

    })

        sections.append({

            "layout": "flat",

    if fp_rows:
        sections.append({
            "title": "Footprint by Project",
            "layout": "flat",
            "unit": "Homepass",
            "rows": [{"actor": x["project"], "value": x["hp"]} for x in fp_rows]
        })

    def add_hierarchy(title, items):
        if not items: return
        sections.append({
            "title": title,
            "layout": "flat",
            "unit": "Orders",
            "rows": [{"actor": x["name"], "value": x["so_mtd"], "cells": [x["so_mtd"], x["sa_mtd"], x["pa_mtd"]]} for x in items],
            "columns": ["SO", "SA", "PA"]
        })
        
    add_hierarchy("Sales Manager Performance", sm_list)
    add_hierarchy("Team Leader Performance", tl_list)
    add_hierarchy("AE Performance (Top 15)", ae_list)

    return {
        "scope": {"circle": circle, "filter_type": filter_type, "filter_value": filter_value, "data_as_of": max_dt, "month_id": cur_mth},
        "sections": sections
    }

1: ================================================================================
2: FTTH INSIGHT HUB — COMPLETE KNOWLEDGE BASE FOR REPLICATION
3: ================================================================================
4: Purpose : A single self-contained reference to rebuild the entire FTTH sales &
5:           territory monitoring platform on a NEW stack (mobile + web) with a
6:           Google BigQuery backend.
7: Source  : Reverse-engineered from the production PHP/MySQL app "FTTH Insight Hub"
8:           (Circle Java, Indosat HiFi / IOH).
9: Audience: Engineers + analysts implementing the replacement.
10: Notes   : [BQ] callouts = how to translate a concept to BigQuery.
11:           All times are Asia/Jakarta (WIB). Currency = IDR (Rupiah).
12: ================================================================================
13: 
14: 
15: ################################################################################
16: # 0. EXECUTIVE SUMMARY — WHAT THIS SYSTEM IS
17: ################################################################################
18: 
19: FTTH Insight Hub monitors the fiber-to-the-home (FTTH) SALES FUNNEL and
20: TERRITORY/MARKET performance for "Circle Java" (Central Java + East Java) and
21: the wider Indonesia circles. It answers:
22: 
23:   1. SALES FUNNEL  : How many orders convert SO -> SA -> PA, by whom, where,
24:                      which product, vs target, vs last month.
25:   2. TERRITORY/TUR : How well is built fiber (homepass) being utilized
26:                      (Take-Up Rate), where is idle capacity, net adds.
27:   3. MARKET SHARE  : Indosat HiFi's share vs competitors per territory.
28:   4. PEOPLE        : Per-person/team productivity, cost efficiency (cost ratio).
29:   5. REPORTING     : Automated daily email (HTML + Excel + PDF) reports.
30: 
31: THE THREE FUNNEL STAGES (the heart of everything):
32:   SO = Service Order      (a customer ordered FTTH; counted on date_so)
33:   SA = Service Active     (service was activated; counted on date_sa)
34:   PA = Permanent Active   (became a permanent/billing subscriber; on date_pa)
35:   Funnel: SO -> SA -> PA. PA is the money/revenue event.
36:   IMPORTANT TERMINOLOGY:
37:     PA = "Permanent Active" (NOT "provisioning active").
38:     AP = "Advance Payment" product (multi-month prepaid FTTH package).
39:     TUR = "Take-Up Rate" = PA / homepass.
40:     MTD = Month-To-Date. LMTD = Last Month-To-Date. LLMTD = month before LMTD.
41: 
42: CRITICAL DESIGN RULE #1 — MULTI-DATE COUNTING:
43:   Each funnel stage is counted on ITS OWN event date, never a shared date.
44:     SO count  = rows where date_so in period
45:     SA count  = rows where has_sa=1 AND date_sa in period
46:     PA count  = rows where has_pa=1 AND date_pa in period
47:   This means a single order contributes to SO in the month it was ordered,
48:   SA in the month it activated, PA in the month it became permanent — possibly
49:   three different months. Do NOT use a single "transaction date".
50: 
51: CRITICAL DESIGN RULE #2 — MTD CUTOFF ("apples-to-apples"):
52:   "Today" for MTD is the MAX DATA DAY actually loaded (e.g. data up to the 14th),
53:   NOT the calendar day. The same day-of-month cap is applied to the current
54:   month AND prior months so MTD vs LMTD vs LLMTD compare equal windows:
55:     current : date_so in current month AND DAY(date_so) <= cutoff_day
56:     LMTD    : date_so in prev month    AND DAY(date_so) <= cutoff_day
57:   Reports/files are titled with the DATA date, not the run date.
58: 
59: CRITICAL DESIGN RULE #3 — TWO ANALYTIC DOMAINS, DIFFERENT GRAINS:
60:   A) TRANSACTION/FUNNEL domain  -> per-order facts (SO/SA/PA), revenue, sales
61:      hierarchy. Source = db_ftth_so/sa/pa -> pre-joined into ftth_raw_joined.
62:   B) SITE/TUR domain            -> per-site MONTHLY snapshot (homepass, pa,
63:      net add). Source = db_ftth_sitewise_monthly.
64:   C) MARKET SHARE domain        -> per-kabkota WEEKLY snapshot of all operators.
65:      Source = fb_ms_ftth.
66:   These three never mix at the row level; keep them as separate fact tables.
67: 
68: 
69: ################################################################################
70: # 1. SALES & TERRITORY HIERARCHY (the dimensional backbone)
71: ################################################################################
72: 
73: SALES HIERARCHY (top -> bottom):
74:   Circle  ->  Sales Region (Region Head/RM)  ->  Sales Manager (SM)
75:           ->  Team Leader (TL)  ->  Account Executive (AE / sales_code)
76: 
77:   - "Circle" is NOT stored on transaction rows; it is DERIVED from sales_region
78:     via a mapping table (tbl_ftth_region_head). A circle filter expands to a
79:     set of sales_region values.
80:   - AE identity = sales_code (+ sales_name). TL = sales_tl. SM = sales_manager.
81:     Region = sales_region.
82: 
83: TERRITORY HIERARCHY (geographic, independent of sales hierarchy):
84:   Circle -> Province (provinsi) -> Kabupaten/Kota (city/kabkota)
85:          -> Kecamatan -> Kelurahan/Desa (ward)
86: 
87: CURRENT CANONICAL TERRITORY CODES (post 2026-06 restructure — IMPORTANT):
88:   The sales_region codes were renumbered/split. The NEW canonical set:
89:     01. Jabodetabek 1   -> CIRCLE JAYA      (head: F Edwin Sukisman)
90:     02. Jabodetabek 2   -> CIRCLE JAYA      (head: F Edwin Sukisman)
91:     03. West Java       -> CIRCLE JAYA      (head: Arie Wibowo)
92:     04. Central Java    -> CIRCLE JAVA      (head: Afdhalul Amri)
93:     05. East Java       -> CIRCLE JAVA      (head: Jusuf Kurniawan)
94:     06. North Sumatera  -> CIRCLE SUMATERA  (head: Reno Antonio)
95:     07. South Sumatera  -> CIRCLE SUMATERA  (head: Reno Antonio)
96:     08. Telesales       -> NON DIRECT       (head: Nisa Aprihatin)
97:   OLD codes (pre-restructure), still present in some history -> map by NAME:
98:     "03. Central Java"(old) -> "04. Central Java"(new); "04. East Java"(old) ->
99:     "05. East Java"(new); "02. West Java"(old) -> "03. West Java"(new);
100:     "01. Jabodetabek"(old) -> split into "01/02 Jabodetabek 1/2" per kecamatan;
101:     "05. Sumatera"(old) -> split into "06/07 North/South Sumatera" per kecamatan;
102:     "06. Non Direct"(old) -> "08. Telesales"(new).
103:   LESSON FOR BQ: store region as a DIMENSION TABLE keyed by a stable region
104:   NAME (Central Java, East Java, ...) + a circle. When mixing months, normalize
105:   by NAME (strip the "NN. " numeric prefix) to avoid double-counting old vs new.
106: 
107: PROVINCE -> CIRCLE mapping (used by geo views):
108:   CIRCLE JAYA     = JAWA BARAT, DKI JAKARTA, BANTEN
109:   CIRCLE JAVA     = JAWA TENGAH, JAWA TIMUR, DAERAH ISTIMEWA YOGYAKARTA, BALI
110:   CIRCLE SUMATERA = anything containing "SUMATERA" + ACEH, BENGKULU, JAMBI,
111:                     LAMPUNG, RIAU, KEPULAUAN RIAU, KEPULAUAN BANGKA BELITUNG
112:   OTHER           = unmapped/junk
113: 
114: REGION -> PROVINCES mapping (sales region scope to provinces):
115:   01/02 Jabodetabek -> BANTEN, DKI JAKARTA
116:   03. West Java     -> JAWA BARAT
117:   04. Central Java  -> JAWA TENGAH, DI YOGYAKARTA, YOGYAKARTA
118:   05. East Java     -> JAWA TIMUR, BALI
119:   06. North Sumatera-> ACEH, SUMATERA UTARA, SUMATERA BARAT, RIAU, KEP. RIAU
120:   07. South Sumatera-> SUMATERA SELATAN, BENGKULU, JAMBI, KEP. BANGKA BELITUNG, LAMPUNG
121:   08. Telesales     -> (no province mapping; cross-province channel)

123: JUNK / UNIDENTIFIED IDENTITY VALUES (exclude or bucket as "Unidentified"):
124:   '0x17','0xf','0x2a','null','unknown sales','unknown','unknonwn sales','n/a',
125:   '-','' and NULL/empty.

130: ################################################################################
131: 
132: Currently MySQL DB "Kalisula" (loaded by an external ETL twice daily 03:30 &

134: 
135: --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
136: 2.1 db_ftth_so  (one row per Service Order — the funnel entry)
137: --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
138:   bill_acc           BIGINT     -- billing account = the order key (join key)
139:   date_so            DATE       -- order date (SO event date)
140:   customer_id        VARCHAR

149:   product            VARCHAR     -- product name (encodes AP/Regular, see 4.2)
150:   price              DECIMAL(15,2) -- monthly price (revenue basis)
151:   year_month         VARCHAR     date_val INT
152:   site_id            VARCHAR
153:   site_project_awal  VARCHAR     -- raw project (maps to ORBIT/NON-ORBIT/IFORTE)
154:   site_market        VARCHAR

157:   shp_kabkota, shp_kecamatan, shp_desa VARCHAR  -- shapefile-normalized geo
158: 
159: --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
160: 2.2 db_ftth_sa  (Service Active events; subset of SO by bill_acc)
161: --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
162:   Same columns as SO plus: date_sa DATE, date_so DATE, so_index DATE.
163:   Key = bill_acc. A bill_acc here means it reached SA.
164: 
165: --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
166: 2.3 db_ftth_pa  (Permanent Active events; subset of SA by bill_acc)
167: --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
168:   Same columns as SO plus: date_pa DATE, date_so DATE, so_index DATE.
169:   Key = bill_acc. A bill_acc here means it reached PA. price here = revenue.
170: 
171: --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
172: 2.4 db_ftth_sitewise_monthly  (per-site MONTHLY snapshot — TUR domain)
173: --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
174:   PK ~ (month_id, site_id, brand). One row per site per month.
175:   month_id        VARCHAR(6)  -- 'YYYYMM'
176:   site_id, site_name, system_key, map_id, territory_id
177:   brand           VARCHAR     -- "Orbit" / "Non Orbit" flag (FILTER: flag)
178:   vendor, market, status_area

180:   available_hp    INT/DEC     -- idle capacity = homepass - pa
181:   pa              INT/DEC     -- CUMULATIVE active subscribers (snapshot)
182:   pa_net_latest   INT/DEC     -- MONTHLY NET ADD (can be negative = churn)
183:   ga              INT/DEC     -- gross add in month
184:   grouping_pa_net VARCHAR     -- pre-bucketed TUR band ('0% - 10%'..'100%+')
185:   lat, lng, area_size_m2, area_size_sqkm
186:   provinsi, city, kecamatan, kelurahan, kota_v2
187:   region_25       VARCHAR     -- territory region code (same codes as 1. above)
188:   regional_head, manager, team_leader, nama_sales, sales_code
189:   project_awal    VARCHAR     -- project (ORBIT/NON-ORBIT/IFORTE/Other)
190:   NOTE: "pa" (cumulative subs) here is a DIFFERENT meaning from the funnel "PA
191:         count" in the transaction domain. Keep them mentally separate.
192: 
193: --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
194: 2.5 fb_ms_ftth  (per-kabkota WEEKLY market-share snapshot — MS domain)
195: --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
196:   PK (dt_id, kabkota). dt_id = snapshot DATE (weekly).
197:   For each of 9 operators, 3 wide columns: {ga|churn|total}_{op}
198:     operators: im3, hifi, xl_home, indihome_tsel, biznet, myrepublic, cbn,
199:                icon, oth
200:   BUSINESS RULE: "Industry total" EXCLUDES im3 (Indosat's mobile brand). The 8
201:   operators counted for market share = hifi, indihome_tsel, xl_home, biznet,
202:   myrepublic, cbn, icon, oth.
203:   Operator display names: hifi=Indosat HiFi, indihome_tsel=IndieHome,
204:     xl_home=XL Home, biznet=Biznet, myrepublic=MyRepublic, cbn=CBN,
205:     icon=ICON+, oth=Others.
206:   Territory join table: zz_territory_kecamatan (kabkota -> region, circle).
207:     Must DEDUPE to one row per UPPER(kabkota) via MAX(region), MAX(circle).
208: 
209: [BQ] Land all five as partitioned BigQuery tables:
210:    - db_ftth_so/sa/pa: partition by date_so/date_sa/date_pa, cluster by
211:      sales_region, sales_manager, city.
212:    - sitewise_monthly: partition by a DATE derived from month_id, cluster by
213:      region_25, city.
214:    - fb_ms_ftth: partition by dt_id, cluster by kabkota.
215:

217: ################################################################################
218: # 3. TRANSFORMED (CACHE) DATA MODEL  +  ETL LOGIC
219: ################################################################################
220: 
221: The app pre-computes cache tables (in MySQL DB "db_ftth_app") because querying
222: 380K+ source rows live is 5-6s. Refresh runs daily 05:00 via refresh_cache.php
223: using a zero-downtime TEMP-TABLE SWAP:
224:    CREATE <t>_tmp LIKE <t>;  bulk INSERT;  RENAME <t>->_old,_tmp-><t>;  DROP _old;
225:    then UPDATE <t> SET circle = COALESCE(region_head.circle_name,'OTHER').
226: [BQ] Replace swap with CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE / partition overwrite / MERGE,
227:      and derive `circle` via JOIN to a region dimension during the SELECT.
228: 
229: --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
230: 3.1 ftth_raw_joined  (THE MASTER FACT — 1 row per bill_acc)  *most important*
231: --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
232:   Built by: db_ftth_so so
233:             LEFT JOIN db_ftth_sa sa ON so.bill_acc=sa.bill_acc
234:             LEFT JOIN db_ftth_pa pa ON so.bill_acc=pa.bill_acc
235:   Columns:
236:     bill_acc, date_so, date_sa, date_pa
237:     has_sa  = (sa.bill_acc IS NOT NULL) ? 1 : 0
238:     has_pa  = (pa.bill_acc IS NOT NULL) ? 1 : 0
239:     status  = CASE WHEN has_pa THEN 'PA' WHEN has_sa THEN 'SA_ONLY'
240:                    ELSE 'SO_ONLY' END
241:     days_so_sa = DATEDIFF(date_sa, date_so)   -- activation cycle time
242:     days_so_pa = DATEDIFF(date_pa, date_so)   -- full conversion cycle time
243:     customer_id, username, province, city, ward, street
244:     sales_code, sales_name, sales_tl, sales_manager, sales_region
245:     circle  (derived from sales_region via region dimension)
246:     product, price, site_id, site_project_awal, site_market
247:     latitude, longitude, shp_kabkota, shp_kecamatan, shp_desa
248:   EVERY funnel metric in the app is computed from this table as:
249:     SO  = COUNT(*) where date_so in window
250:     SA  = COUNTIF(has_sa=1 AND date_sa in window)
251:     PA  = COUNTIF(has_pa=1 AND date_pa in window)
252:     Revenue(SO) = SUM(price) over SO-window rows
253:     Revenue(PA) = SUM(IF(has_pa AND date_pa in window, price, 0))
254:     Avg cycle days = AVG(days_so_pa) over PA rows
255: [BQ] This is your central fact table. Model it exactly; all funnel dashboards
256:      are GROUP BYs over it with the multi-date counting rule.
257: 
258: --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
259: 3.2 ftth_daily_sales  (grain: day x sales_code x product x city)
260: --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
261:   GROUP BY date_so, sales_code, product, city (from SO LEFT JOIN SA LEFT JOIN PA)
262:   Measures: so_count, sa_count, pa_count, revenue_so, revenue_pa,
263:             sum_days_so_pa, cnt_days_so_pa (lead-time accumulators)
264:   Dimensions carried via MAX(): sales_name/tl/manager/region/province, circle.
265:   Powers: dashboard filter lists + as a daily aggregate.
266: 
267: --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
268: 3.3 ftth_geo_summary  (grain: month x city x ward)
269: --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
270:   GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(date_so,'%Y-%m'), city, ward
271:   Measures: so_count, sa_count, pa_count, so_only_count, revenue_so,
272:             revenue_pa, avg_price_pa, sum_days_so_pa, cnt_days_so_pa
273:   Province/shp_*/lat/lng carried via MAX()/AVG() (NOT grouped).
274:   GOTCHA: a city/ward under >1 province causes duplicate unique-keys -> use
275:   MAX(province) so (month,city,ward) stays unique.
276: 
277: --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
278: 3.4 ftth_mtd_tracker_daily  (+ geo variant)  — the MTD tracker pre-agg
279: --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
280:   Built by refresh_mtd_tracker_cache.php; trailing 24 months; idempotent
281:   (DELETE month window then 3 INSERT..SELECT, one per metric):
282:     SO: metric_type='SO', count by date_so
283:     SA: metric_type='SA', count by date_sa where has_sa=1
284:     PA: metric_type='PA', count by date_pa where has_pa=1
285:   Grain: (tanggal, metric_type, sales_region, sales_manager, project_group)
286:   Measures: cnt=COUNT(*), revenue=SUM(price); circle derived.
287:   Geo variant ftth_mtd_tracker_geo_daily: grain (tanggal, metric_type,
288:     province, city, project_group).
289:   Auto-refresh: if MAX(date_*) in raw_joined newer than MAX(tanggal) in cache,
290:   rebuild trailing 3 months on-the-fly.
291: [BQ] Implement as a scheduled aggregate table (or just GROUP BY raw fact at
292:      query time — BigQuery is fast enough to skip this pre-agg).
293: 
294: --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
295: 3.5 Filter caches  (fast cascading dropdowns)
296: --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
297:   ftth_cache_hierarchy (~6K): distinct region>manager>tl>sales_code(+name)+circle
298:   ftth_cache_geo (~150): distinct province, city
299:   ftth_cache_product (~55): distinct product
300:   Cross-filter rule: each field's option list is computed with a WHERE that
301:   excludes its own key, so selecting Region narrows SM/TL/AE but not Region.
302: 
303: --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
304: 3.6 ftth_cache_meta  (freshness tracking)
305: --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
306:   cache_name PK, last_refresh, row_count, duration_sec,
307:   status ENUM('success','failed','running'), message.
308: 
309: CRON SCHEDULE (WIB):
310:   03:30 & 16:30  external ETL loads source into Kalisula
311:   05:00          refresh_cache.php (raw_joined, daily, geo, filters, mtd)
312:   06:00          daily_mtd_email.php  (MTD Sales Performance email)
313:   06:30          netadd_profile_email.php (Subs & Net Add email)
314:   Sun 04:00      prune_logs.php (trim access log by retention setting)
315:

317: ################################################################################
318: # 4. SHARED BUSINESS LOGIC / FORMULAS  (replicate as BQ UDFs / shared SQL)
319: ################################################################################
320: 
321: 4.1 GROWTH %  (universal)
322:     growth = (curr - prev) / prev * 100
323:     if prev = 0 and curr > 0 -> 100 ;  if both 0 -> 0
324:     gap = curr - prev
325: 
326: 4.2 AP (ADVANCE PAYMENT) PRODUCT CLASSIFICATION
327:     Detector regex on product name:  ^(AP|Super[ ]?)[0-9]+
328:       type    = 'AP' if matches else 'Regular'
329:       months  = leading integer = prepay duration (AP: 3,4,6,7,12 ; Super: 6,12)
330:       family  = 'AP' (^AP[0-9]+) or 'Super' (^Super ?[0-9]+) or NULL
331:       base    = product with the "AP{n}.../Super {n}..." prefix stripped
332:     Bucket label = CONCAT('AP', months) e.g. AP3/AP4/AP6/AP7/AP12; else 'Regular'.
333:     Filter modes: ''/'all'=no filter; 'AP'=all AP+Super; 'Regular'; 'AP12'
334:       (matches ^AP12 and ^Super ?12); 'family:AP'; 'family:Super'.
335: 
336: 4.3 PROJECT GROUP CLASSIFICATION  (from site_project_awal, case-insensitive)
337:     ORBIT     <- contains 'mplay'
338:     NON-ORBIT <- contains 'seahawk' or 'spartan'
339:     IFORTE    <- contains 'iforte' / 'i-forte' / 'i_forte'
340:     Other     <- NULL/empty/anything else
341:     Used as a filter ("mode": BLENDED=all, ORBIT, NON-ORBIT, IFORTE) and a
342:     breakdown dimension across modules.
343: 
344: 4.4 CONVERSION RATES (funnel)
345:     Conv SO->SA = SA/SO*100
346:     Conv SA->PA = PA/SA*100
347:     Conv SO->PA = PA/SO*100   (overall funnel efficiency)
348: 
349: 4.5 TUR (TAKE-UP RATE)  — site/territory domain
350:     TUR % = SUM(pa) / SUM(homepass) * 100      (pa = cumulative active subs)
351:     Available % = available_hp / homepass * 100
352:     Net Add = SUM(pa_net_latest)               (monthly, can be negative)
353:     Churn (derived) = max(0, GA - Net Add)
354:     5-SLAB segmentation (acquisition view):
355:       extreme_low <10% | low 10-20% | mid 20-30% | high 30-50% | strong >=50%
356:     Map-tur summary buckets differ: low<20 | mid 20-30 | high 30-50 | elite>=50
357:     Source pre-bucket grouping_pa_net (11 bands) maps to the 5 slabs:
358:       0-10%->extreme_low; 10-20%->low; 20-30%->mid; 30-40%&40-50%->high;
359:       everything >=50% (incl 100%+)->strong.
360:     PA Extraction % = PA_month / available_hp * 100  (acquisition efficiency)
361:     SO Extraction % = SO_month / available_hp * 100
362: 
363: 4.6 MARKET SHARE  (MS domain; industry excludes im3)
364:     industry_X = SUM over 8 operators of X (X in {total,ga,churn})
365:     Market Share % = operator_total / industry_total * 100
366:     SoGA % (Share of Gross Add) = operator_ga / industry_ga * 100
367:     SoChurn %                   = operator_churn / industry_churn * 100
368:     Net Add = ga - churn
369:     Delta WoW = current snapshot - previous snapshot value
370:     Delta YoY = current - snapshot nearest to (current_date - 364 days)
371:     Monthly mode = take the LATEST dt_id within each month (NOT sum of weeks).
372:       [BQ] QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY month ORDER BY dt_id DESC)=1
373:     Opportunity score = low operator MS% (< threshold, default 5%) AND high
374:       industry GA (sort by industry_ga desc) = "where the market is moving but
375:       we're weak".
376: 
377: 4.7 ACHIEVEMENT vs TARGET
378:     Targets stored per Sales Manager per month for metric PA only
379:       (table tbl_ftth_target_sm: sales_manager, target_bulan, metric_type='PA',
380:        target_value).
381:     Achievement % = PA_curr / target * 100   (ALWAYS measured on PA, not SA)
382:     Gap = PA_curr - target
383:     Traffic light: <80% red, 80-95% amber, >=95% green.
384: 
385: 4.8 COST RATIO  (people-cost efficiency)
386:     Per-level monthly cost from config (defaults: AE=3,800,000; TL=7,000,000;
387:       SM=20,000,000; RM configurable) in tbl_ftth_cost_config.
388:     headcounts via COUNT(DISTINCT sales_code / sales_tl / sales_manager /
389:       sales_region).
390:     total_cost = AE_cnt*AE_cost + TL_cnt*TL_cost + SM_cnt*SM_cost + RM_cnt*RM_cost
391:     cost_ratio % = total_cost / revenue_pa * 100   (999.99 if revenue=0)
392:     gap = total_cost - revenue_pa  (positive = loss)
393:     BEP_pa = ceil(total_cost / avg_price_pa)
394:     SO_needed_BEP = ceil(BEP_pa / hist_conv_so_pa)
395:     Ideal (10% target): ideal_pa = ceil(total_cost / (0.10*avg_price_pa))
396:     Status: ratio>100 LOSS; >=95 BREAK-EVEN; >10 BELOW TARGET; else IDEAL.
397: 
398: 4.9 MTD CUTOFF / TRENDED TRIO (used by tracker + all reports)
399:     cutoff_day = DAY( MAX(date_so) in data )   [the locked "today"]
400:     Trio per metric: prev2 (LLMTD, month-2), prev1 (LMTD, month-1), curr (MTD),
401:     each capped at DAY(col) <= cutoff_day. growth = (curr-prev1)/prev1*100.
402: 
403: 4.10 DORMANCY / STREAK (heatmap, evaluation, people)
404:     dormant threshold (days) = max(3, floor(cutoff_day * 0.2)) (and cutoff>=5)
405:     streak = consecutive active days; dormant_days = trailing zero days.
406:     Evaluation issue flags (relative to team averages of active AEs, so>0):
407:       zero_performer so=0; low_so 0<so<avgSO*0.5; low_conversion so>=3 AND
408:       (pa/so)<avgConvPA*0.5; slow_activation avgDays>teamAvgDays*2;
409:       low_rev_per_pa pa>0 AND rev/pa<avgRevPerPA*0.5; declining prevSO>3 AND
410:       so<prevSO*0.5; dormant days since last_so > 10.
411:

100: LEVELS: dict[str, dict] = {
101:     "circle": {"col": "t.circle", "label": "circle", "parent": None},
102:     "region": {"col": "t.region", "label": "region", "parent": "t.circle"},
103:     "area": {"col": "t.area_im3", "label": "area", "parent": "t.region"},
104:     "branch": {"col": "t.branch_im3", "label": "branch", "parent": "t.area_im3"},
105:     "kabkota": {"col": "t.kabkot", "label": "kabkota", "parent": "t.branch_im3"},
106:     "kecamatan": {"col": "t.kec_id", "label": "kecamatan", "parent": "t.kabkot"},
107:     "microcluster": {"col": "t.micro_cluster_im3", "label": "microcluster", "parent": "t.branch_im3"},
108:     "supergtm": {"col": "t.super_gtm", "label": "supergtm", "parent": "t.region"},
109: }
110: 
111: # Parent filter column for drilling INTO a level (filter on the parent value)
112: DRILL_PARENT_COL = {
113:     "region": "t.circle",
114:     "area": "t.region",
115:     "branch": "t.area_im3",
116:     "kabkota": "t.branch_im3",
117:     "kecamatan": "t.kabkot",
118: }
119: 
120: 
121: def _esc(v: str) -> str:
122:     return (v or "").replace("'", "")
123: 
124: 
125: def _is_all(circle: str) -> bool:
126:     return (circle or "").strip().upper() == "ALL"
127: 
128: 
129: def _circle_clause(circle: str, col: str = "t.circle") -> str:
130:     """WHERE fragment for the circle filter. 'ALL' → no restriction (1=1)."""
131:     if _is_all(circle):
132:         return "1=1"
133:     return f"{col} = '{_esc(circle)}'"
134: 
135: 
136: def _latest_month() -> int:
137:     r = run_query(f"SELECT MAX(month_id) AS m FROM {_MTD}")
138:     return int(r["rows"][0]["m"])
139: 
140: 
141: def _brand_split(expr: str, prefix: str) -> str:
142:     """Emit IOH/IM3/3ID columns for a value expression at one timeframe."""
143:     return (
144:         f"COALESCE(SUM({expr}),0) AS {prefix}_ioh, "
145:         f"COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN x.brand='IM3' THEN {expr} END),0) AS {prefix}_im3, "
146:         f"COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN x.brand='3ID' THEN {expr} END),0) AS {prefix}_3id"
147:     )
148: 
149: 
150: def _territory_filter(filter_type: str, filter_value: str) -> str:
151:     """Optional scope filter clause (ANDed)."""
152:     if not filter_value:
153:         return ""
154:     col = {
155:         "region": "t.region",
156:         "area": "t.area_im3",
157:         "branch": "t.branch_im3",
158:         "kabkota": "t.kabkot",
159:         "microcluster": "t.micro_cluster_im3",
160:         "supergtm": "t.super_gtm",
161:         "island": "t.island",
162:     }.get(filter_type)
163:     if not col:
164:         return ""
165:     return f" AND {col} = '{_esc(filter_value)}'"
166: 
167: 
168: def _level_summary(metric: dict, level: str, circle: str, month_id: int,
169:                    filter_clause: str, order: str = "var",
170:                    limit: Optional[int] = None) -> dict:
171:     """One brand-banded table for a territory level with LLMTD/LMTD/MTD x IOH/IM3/3ID
172:     plus abs_growth (Var IOH) and growth_pct."""
173:     lv = LEVELS[level]
174:     grain = lv["col"]
175:     parent = lv["parent"]
176:     expr = metric["expr"]
177:     lmtd = month_id - 1
178:     llmtd = month_id - 2
179: 
180:     parent_sel = f"MIN({parent}) AS parent," if parent else ""
181: 
182:     def block(alias: str, mid: int) -> str:
183:         return f"""{alias} AS (
184:   SELECT {grain} AS grain,
185:     {_brand_split(expr, 'v')}
186:   FROM {_MTD} x
187:   LEFT JOIN {_TERR} t ON x.kec_id = t.kec_id
188:   WHERE {_circle_clause(circle)}{filter_clause} AND x.month_id={mid} AND {grain} IS NOT NULL
189:   GROUP BY grain
190: )"""
191: 
192:     if order == "var":
193:         order_by = "ORDER BY abs_growth_ioh ASC"  # worst-first
194:     elif order == "mtd_desc":
195:         order_by = "ORDER BY mtd_ioh DESC"
196:     else:
197:         order_by = "ORDER BY abs_growth_ioh ASC"
198:     lim = f"\nLIMIT {limit}" if limit else ""
199: 
200:     # parent label must come from the MTD block; re-derive via a join to territory
201:     parent_join = ""
202:     parent_col = "CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS parent"
203:     if parent:
204:         parent_join = f"""LEFT JOIN (
205:   SELECT {grain} AS grain, MIN({parent}) AS parent
206:   FROM {_TERR} t
207:   WHERE {_circle_clause(circle)}{filter_clause} AND {grain} IS NOT NULL
208:   GROUP BY grain
209: ) p ON m.grain = p.grain"""
210:         parent_col = "p.parent AS parent"
211: 
212:     sql = f"""
213: WITH
214: {block('mtd', month_id)},
215: {block('lmtd', lmtd)},
216: {block('llmtd', llmtd)}
217: SELECT
218:   m.grain AS name,
219:   {parent_col},
220:   COALESCE(l2.v_ioh,0) AS llmtd_ioh, COALESCE(l1.v_ioh,0) AS lmtd_ioh, m.v_ioh AS mtd_ioh,
221:   (m.v_ioh - COALESCE(l1.v_ioh,0)) AS abs_growth_ioh,
222:   SAFE_DIVIDE(m.v_ioh - COALESCE(l1.v_ioh,0), NULLIF(l1.v_ioh,0)) * 100 AS growth_pct,
223:   COALESCE(l2.v_im3,0) AS llmtd_im3, COALESCE(l1.v_im3,0) AS lmtd_im3, m.v_im3 AS mtd_im3,
224:   (m.v_im3 - COALESCE(l1.v_im3,0)) AS abs_growth_im3,
225:   SAFE_DIVIDE(m.v_im3 - COALESCE(l1.v_im3,0), NULLIF(l1.v_im3,0)) * 100 AS growth_pct_im3,
226:   COALESCE(l2.v_3id,0) AS llmtd_3id, COALESCE(l1.v_3id,0) AS lmtd_3id, m.v_3id AS mtd_3id,
227:   (m.v_3id - COALESCE(l1.v_3id,0)) AS abs_growth_3id,
228:   SAFE_DIVIDE(m.v_3id - COALESCE(l1.v_3id,0), NULLIF(l1.v_3id,0)) * 100 AS growth_pct_3id
229: FROM mtd m
230: LEFT JOIN lmtd l1 ON m.grain = l1.grain
231: LEFT JOIN llmtd l2 ON m.grain = l2.grain
232: {parent_join}
233: {order_by}{lim}
234: """
235:     res = run_query(sql, row_limit=5000)
236:     return res
237: 
238: 
239: def _compute_slabs(rows: list[dict]) -> dict:
240:     """8-bucket growth_pct distribution (worst→best) for health bars."""
241:     out = {"total": 0, "declining": 0, "growing": 0,
242:            "decline_gt5": 0, "decline_3_5": 0, "decline_1_3": 0, "decline_0_1": 0,
243:            "growth_0_1": 0, "growth_1_3": 0, "growth_3_5": 0, "growth_gt5": 0}
244:     for r in rows:
245:         p = r.get("growth_pct")
246:         if p is None or (isinstance(p, float) and math.isnan(p)):
247:             continue
248:         out["total"] += 1
249:         if p < 0:
250:             out["declining"] += 1
251:             if p <= -5:
252:                 out["decline_gt5"] += 1
253:             elif p <= -3:
254:                 out["decline_3_5"] += 1
255:             elif p <= -1:
256:                 out["decline_1_3"] += 1
257:             else:
258:                 out["decline_0_1"] += 1
259:         else:
260:             out["growing"] += 1
261:             if p >= 5:
262:                 out["growth_gt5"] += 1
263:             elif p >= 3:
264:                 out["growth_3_5"] += 1
265:             elif p >= 1:
266:                 out["growth_1_3"] += 1
267:             else:
268:                 out["growth_0_1"] += 1
269:     return out
270: 
271: 
272: def _scale(peak: float, unit: str) -> dict:
273:     if unit == "GB" and peak >= 100_000:
274:         return {"divisor": 1_000, "unit": "K GB"}
275:     if peak >= 100_000_000:
276:         return {"divisor": 1_000_000, "unit": f"Mn {unit}"}
277:     if peak >= 100_000:
278:         return {"divisor": 1_000, "unit": f"K {unit}"}
279:     return {"divisor": 1, "unit": unit}
280:

308: @router.get("/territory-tree")
309: def territory_tree(circle: str = "JAVA"):
310:     """Region → Area → Branch tree for the scope picker."""
311:     try:
312:         sql = f"""
313: SELECT t.region, t.area_im3 AS area, t.branch_im3 AS branch
314: FROM {_TERR} t
315: WHERE {_circle_clause(circle)} AND t.region IS NOT NULL
316: GROUP BY t.region, t.area_im3, t.branch_im3
317: ORDER BY t.region, area, branch
318: """
319:         res = run_query(sql, row_limit=5000)
320:     except QueryError as e:
321:         return {"error": str(e), "kind": "validation"}
322:     except Exception as e:
323:         return {"error": str(e)[:300], "kind": "execution"}
324: 
325:     tree: dict = {}
326:     for r in res["rows"]:
327:         reg = r.get("region") or "—"
328:         area = r.get("area") or "—"
329:         br = r.get("branch")
330:         tree.setdefault(reg, {})
331:         tree[reg].setdefault(area, [])
332:         if br and br not in tree[reg][area]:
333:             tree[reg][area].append(br)
334:     return {
335:         "circle": circle,
336:         "tree": [
337:             {"region": reg,
338:              "areas": [{"area": a, "branches": brs} for a, brs in areas.items()]}
339:             for reg, areas in tree.items()
340:         ],
341:     }
342:

344: # Map an api filter level to its territory column.
345: _SCOPE_COL = {
346:     "region": "t.region", "area": "t.area_im3", "branch": "t.branch_im3",
347:     "kabkota": "t.kabkot", "kecamatan": "t.kec_id",
348:     "microcluster": "t.micro_cluster_im3", "supergtm": "t.super_gtm",
349: }

352: @router.get("/scope-options")
353: def scope_options(
354:     circle: str = Query("JAVA"), 
355:     level: str = Query("region"),
356:     parent_type: str = Query(""),
357:     parent_value: str = Query("")
358: ):
359:     """Distinct scope values for a territory level within a circle, optionally filtered by a parent."""
360:     if not _is_all(circle) and circle not in CIRCLES:
361:         return {"error": f"unknown circle '{circle}'", "kind": "validation"}
362:     col = _SCOPE_COL.get(level)
363:     if not col:
364:         return {"error": f"unknown level '{level}'", "kind": "validation"}
365:     
366:     parent_filter = ""
367:     if parent_type and parent_value:
368:         pcol = _SCOPE_COL.get(parent_type)
369:         if pcol:
370:             parent_filter = f" AND {pcol} = '{_esc(parent_value)}'"
371:             
372:     try:
373:         sql = f"""
374: SELECT DISTINCT {col} AS value
375: FROM {_TERR} t
376: WHERE {_circle_clause(circle)} AND {col} IS NOT NULL {parent_filter}
377: ORDER BY value
378: """
379:         res = run_query(sql, row_limit=10000)
380:     except QueryError as e:
381:         return {"error": str(e), "kind": "validation"}
382:     except Exception as e:
383:         return {"error": str(e)[:300], "kind": "execution"}
384:     return {"circle": circle, "level": level,
385:             "values": [r["value"] for r in res["rows"] if r.get("value")]}

389:     metric: dict

391:     display: dict

397: @router.get("/snapshot")
398: def snapshot(
399:     metric: str = Query("rev_prepaid"),
400:     circle: str = Query("JAVA"),
401:     filter_type: str = Query("all"),
402:     filter_value: str = Query(""),
403:     month_id: Optional[int] = Query(None),
404:     refresh: bool = Query(False, description="bypass cache and rebuild"),
405: ):
406:     """Daily Snapshot for one metric (cached, auto-refreshed when BQ dt_id_snapshot changes)."""
407:     if not _METRIC_BY_CODE.get(metric):
408:         return {"error": f"unknown metric '{metric}'", "kind": "validation"}
409:     if not _is_all(circle) and circle not in CIRCLES:
410:         return {"error": f"unknown circle '{circle}'", "kind": "validation"}
411:     key = f"{metric}|{circle}|{filter_type}|{filter_value}|{month_id}"
412:     return reports_cache.get_or_build(
413:         "snapshot", key,
414:         lambda: _snapshot_build(metric, circle, filter_type, filter_value, month_id),
415:         force=refresh)
416: 
417: 
418: def _snapshot_build(metric, circle, filter_type, filter_value, month_id):
419:     m = _METRIC_BY_CODE.get(metric)
420:     fc = _territory_filter(filter_type, filter_value)
421:     try:
422:         mid = int(month_id) if month_id else _latest_month()
423: 
424:         # 1. circle-level rows. When circle=ALL this returns one row per circle;
425:         #    KPI totals below sum across them.
426:         circ = _level_summary(m, "circle", circle, mid, fc, order="mtd_desc")
427:         crow = circ["rows"][0] if circ["rows"] else {}
428: 
429:         # 2. region summary (full table, MTD desc).
430:         region = _level_summary(m, "region", circle, mid, fc, order="mtd_desc")
431: 
432:         # 3. branch table for best/worst chips + slabs + deck.
433:         branch = _level_summary(m, "branch", circle, mid, fc, order="var")
434: 
435:         # 4. kecamatan table for the health distribution slabs.
436:         kec = _level_summary(m, "kecamatan", circle, mid, fc, order="var")
437: 
438:         # 5. full deck: top/bottom rankings (ref §4.3). Level summaries are
439:         #    ordered Var IOH ASC (worst-first): decline = head, growth = tail rev.
440:         mc = _level_summary(m, "microcluster", circle, mid, fc, order="var")
441:         kab = _level_summary(m, "kabkota", circle, mid, fc, order="var")
442:     except QueryError as e:
443:         return {"error": str(e), "kind": "validation"}
444:     except Exception as e:
445:         return {"error": str(e)[:400], "kind": "execution"}
446: 
447:     brows = branch["rows"]
448:     # best/worst by Var IOH
449:     worst = brows[0] if brows else None
450:     best = brows[-1] if brows else None
451: 
452:     def _rankings(res: dict, n: int = 10) -> dict:
453:         """Top-10 decline (most negative Var) + top-10 growth (most positive),
454:         keeping full brand-banded rows so the UI renders them like the branch
455:         table."""
456:         rows = res["rows"]
457:         ranked = [r for r in rows if r.get("abs_growth_ioh") is not None]
458:         decline = ranked[:n]
459:         growth = list(reversed(ranked[-n:])) if ranked else []
460:         return {"columns": res["columns"], "decline": decline, "growth": growth}
461: 
462:     # KPI totals = sum across all circle rows (1 row for a single circle, N for ALL).
463:     def _sumk(rows, k):
464:         return sum(float(r.get(k) or 0) for r in rows)
465:     crows = circ["rows"]
466:     mtd_ioh = _sumk(crows, "mtd_ioh")
467:     lmtd_ioh = _sumk(crows, "lmtd_ioh")
468:     llmtd_ioh = _sumk(crows, "llmtd_ioh")
469:     mtd_im3 = _sumk(crows, "mtd_im3")
470:     mtd_3id = _sumk(crows, "mtd_3id")
471:     abs_change = mtd_ioh - lmtd_ioh
472:     pct_change = (abs_change / lmtd_ioh * 100) if lmtd_ioh else None
473: 
474:     # display scaling from peak across rendered tables
475:     peak = 0.0
476:     for r in [crow] + brows + kec["rows"]:
477:         for k in ("llmtd_ioh", "lmtd_ioh", "mtd_ioh"):
478:             peak = max(peak, abs(float(r.get(k) or 0)))
479:     disp = _scale(peak, m["unit"])
480: 
481:     kec_slabs = _compute_slabs(kec["rows"])
482:     branch_slabs = _compute_slabs(brows)
483: 
484:     deck = {
485:         "circle": {"columns": circ["columns"], "rows": circ["rows"]},
486:         "region": {"columns": region["columns"], "rows": region["rows"]},
487:         "branch": {"columns": branch["columns"], "rows": brows},
488:         "microcluster": _rankings(mc),
489:         "kabkota": _rankings(kab),
490:         "kecamatan": _rankings(kec),
491:         "counts": {
492:             "circle": len(circ["rows"]),
493:             "region": len(region["rows"]),
494:             "microcluster": len(mc["rows"]),
495:             "kabkota": len(kab["rows"]),
496:             "kecamatan": len(kec["rows"]),
497:             "branch": len(brows),
498:         },
499:     }
500: 
501:     return {
502:         "metric": {"code": m["code"], "name": m["name"], "unit": m["unit"], "category": m["category"]},
503:         "scope": {"circle": circle, "filter_type": filter_type,
504:                   "filter_value": filter_value, "month_id": mid,
505:                   "data_as_of": reports_cache.data_marker("highlevel")},
506:         "display": disp,
507:         "totals": {
508:             "mtd": mtd_ioh, "lmtd": lmtd_ioh, "llmtd": llmtd_ioh,
509:             "mtd_im3": mtd_im3, "mtd_3id": mtd_3id,
510:             "abs_change": abs_change, "pct_change": pct_change,
511:             "trend": "up" if abs_change >= 0 else "down",
512:         },
513:         "best": {"name": best.get("name"), "var": best.get("abs_growth_ioh"),
514:                  "pct": best.get("growth_pct")} if best else None,
515:         "worst": {"name": worst.get("name"), "var": worst.get("abs_growth_ioh"),
516:                   "pct": worst.get("growth_pct")} if worst else None,
517:         "branch": {"columns": branch["columns"], "rows": brows},
518:         "slabs": {"kecamatan": kec_slabs, "branch": branch_slabs},
519:         "deck": deck,
520:         "meta": {"bytes_processed": (circ.get("bytes_processed", 0)
521:                                      + branch.get("bytes_processed", 0)
522:                                      + kec.get("bytes_processed", 0))},
523:     }
524: 
525: 
526: def _guarded(builder):
527:     """Run a builder with the standard error envelope."""
528:     try:
529:         return builder()
530:     except QueryError as e:
531:         return {"error": str(e), "kind": "validation"}
532:     except Exception as e:
533:         return {"error": str(e)[:400], "kind": "execution"}

592: @router.get("/locate")
593: def locate(lat: float = Query(...), lon: float = Query(...)):
594:     """Lightweight: map a GPS point to its territory hierarchy (no reports).
595:     Used by My Coordinate to populate the level picker before loading a report."""
596:     from . import geo_locate
597:     loc = geo_locate.locate_kecamatan(lat, lon)
598:     if not loc or not loc.get("kec_id"):
599:         return {"error": "Koordinat tidak termasuk dalam wilayah yang dipetakan.", "kind": "not_found"}
600:     kid = str(loc["kec_id"]).replace("'", "")
601:     try:
602:         terr = run_query(

623: @router.get("/my-coordinate")
624: def my_coordinate(
625:     lat: float = Query(...),
626:     lon: float = Query(...),
627:     month_id: Optional[int] = Query(None),
628:     refresh: bool = Query(False),
629: ):
630:     """My Coordinate: locate the GPS point to a kecamatan via the SHP, resolve
631:     its full territory hierarchy, then return a Comprehensive payload for each
632:     level (kecamatan / kabkota / microcluster / branch / area / region) — same
633:     structure & UI as the Comprehensive report, scoped automatically."""
634:     from . import geo_locate
635:     loc = geo_locate.locate_kecamatan(lat, lon)
636:     if not loc or not loc.get("kec_id"):
637:         return {"error": "Koordinat tidak termasuk dalam wilayah Java yang dipetakan.",
638:                 "kind": "not_found"}
639:     kid = str(loc["kec_id"]).replace("'", "")
640:     try:
641:         terr = run_query(
642:             f"SELECT circle, region, area_im3, branch_im3, micro_cluster_im3, kabkot, kecamatan "
643:             f"FROM {_TERR} WHERE kec_id='{kid}' LIMIT 1", row_limit=2)
644:     except Exception as e:
645:         return {"error": str(e)[:300], "kind": "execution"}
646:     if not terr["rows"]:
647:         return {"error": "Kecamatan tidak ditemukan di tabel territory.", "kind": "not_found"}
648:     t = terr["rows"][0]
649:     circle = t.get("circle") or "JAVA"
650:     if circle not in CIRCLES:
651:         circle = "JAVA"
652: 
653:     # ordered levels (most specific → broadest)
654:     levels = [
655:         ("kecamatan", "Kecamatan", t.get("kecamatan"), kid),
656:         ("kabkota", "Kab/Kota", t.get("kabkot"), t.get("kabkot")),
657:         ("microcluster", "Micro Cluster", t.get("micro_cluster_im3"), t.get("micro_cluster_im3")),
658:         ("branch", "Branch", t.get("branch_im3"), t.get("branch_im3")),
659:         ("area", "Area", t.get("area_im3"), t.get("area_im3")),
660:         ("region", "Region", t.get("region"), t.get("region")),
661:     ]
662: 
663:     out_levels = []
664:     for ftype, label, name, fvalue in levels:
665:         if not fvalue:
666:             continue
667:         key = f"mycoord|{circle}|{ftype}|{fvalue}|{month_id}"
668:         payload = reports_cache.get_or_build(
669:             "comprehensive", key,
670:             lambda ft=ftype, fv=fvalue: _guarded(lambda: reports_comprehensive.build_comprehensive(
671:                 circle, month_id, ft, fv)),
672:             force=refresh)
673:         out_levels.append({"level": ftype, "label": label, "name": name, "report": payload})
674: 
675:     return {
676:         "located": {"kec_id": kid, "kecamatan": t.get("kecamatan"), "kabkota": t.get("kabkot"),
677:                     "microcluster": t.get("micro_cluster_im3"), "branch": t.get("branch_im3"),
678:                     "area": t.get("area_im3"), "region": t.get("region"), "circle": circle,
679:                     "lat": lat, "lon": lon},
680:         "levels": out_levels,
681:     }

105: function fmtNum(v: number | null | undefined, divisor = 1, dec = 1): string {
106:   if (v === null || v === undefined || isNaN(v as number)) return "—";
107:   return ((v as number) / divisor).toLocaleString("id-ID", { minimumFractionDigits: dec, maximumFractionDigits: dec });
108: }
109: function fmtPct(v: number | null | undefined): string {
110:   if (v === null || v === undefined || isNaN(v as number)) return "—";
111:   return `${(v as number) >= 0 ? "+" : ""}${(v as number).toLocaleString("id-ID", { minimumFractionDigits: 1, maximumFractionDigits: 1 })}%`;
112: }
113: function fmtVar(v: number | null | undefined, divisor = 1): string {
114:   if (v === null || v === undefined || isNaN(v as number)) return "—";
115:   return `${(v as number) >= 0 ? "▲" : "▼"} ${fmtNum(Math.abs(v as number), divisor)}`;
116: }
117: function fmtMn(v: number): string { return (v / 1e6).toLocaleString("id-ID", { minimumFractionDigits: 1, maximumFractionDigits: 1 }); }
118: function scaleUnit(peak: number, unit: string): { divisor: number; unit: string } {
119:   if (unit === "GB" && peak >= 1e5) return { divisor: 1e3, unit: "K GB" };
120:   if (peak >= 1e8) return { divisor: 1e6, unit: `Mn ${unit}` };
121:   if (peak >= 1e5) return { divisor: 1e3, unit: `K ${unit}` };
122:   return { divisor: 1, unit };
123: }
124: function fmtBy(kind: string, v: number | null | undefined): string {
125:   if (v === null || v === undefined || isNaN(v as number)) return "—";
126:   if (kind === "%") return fmtPct(v);
127:   if (kind === "ratio") return (v as number).toLocaleString("id-ID", { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 });
128:   if (kind === "GB") return (v as number).toLocaleString("id-ID", { minimumFractionDigits: 1, maximumFractionDigits: 1 });
129:   return (v as number).toLocaleString("id-ID", { maximumFractionDigits: 0 });
130: }
