211:       warm(`ftth|${dataVer}|${cir}|${sp}`, `/api/reports/ftth?circle=${c}${sp}`);
212:     }, 1500);
213:   }, [dataVer, brand]);
214: 
215:   const pickLevel = useCallback((lv: { level: string; name: string; value?: string }) => {
216:     const val = lv.value ?? lv.name; setMcPick(lv.level); setScopeType(lv.level); setScopeValue(val); setBreakdownValue("Total"); prefetchAll(circle, lv.level, val);
217:   }, [prefetchAll, circle]);
218: 
219:   const locateMe = useCallback(() => {
220:     setGeoErr(""); setMcLevels(null);
221:     if (!navigator.geolocation) { setGeoErr("Geolocation tidak didukung."); return; }
222:     setLoading(true);
223:     navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition(async (pos) => {
224:       try {
225:         const r = await authFetch(`/api/reports/locate?lat=${pos.coords.latitude}&lon=${pos.coords.longitude}`);
226:         const d = await r.json();
227:         if (d.error) { setGeoErr(d.error); setLoading(false); } else {
228:           if (d.circle) setCircle(d.circle);
229:           const lvls = (d.levels || []).filter((x: { name?: string }) => x.name);
230:           setMcLevels(lvls);
231:           if (lvls[0]) { 
232:             const v0 = lvls[0].value ?? lvls[0].name; 
233:             setMcPick(lvls[0].level); setScopeType(lvls[0].level); setScopeValue(v0); setBreakdownValue("Total");
234:             prefetchAll(d.circle || circle, lvls[0].level, v0); 
235:             // Do not call setLoading(false) here. The main useEffect will trigger and handle it.
236:           } else {
237:             setLoading(false);
238:           }
239:         }
240:       } catch (e) { setGeoErr(String(e)); setLoading(false); }
241:     }, (e) => { setGeoErr("Gagal: " + e.message); setLoading(false); }, { enableHighAccuracy: true, timeout: 15000 });
242:   }, [prefetchAll, circle]);
243: 
244:   const [reloadKey, setReloadKey] = useState(0);
245:   const activeScopeType = breakdownValue !== "Total" ? CHILD_LEVEL[scopeType] : scopeType;
246:   const activeScopeValue = breakdownValue !== "Total" ? breakdownValue : scopeValue;
247:   const scopeParams = (activeScopeType !== "all" && activeScopeValue) ? `&filter_type=${activeScopeType}&filter_value=${encodeURIComponent(activeScopeValue)}` : "";
248: 
249:   useEffect(() => {
250:     let ignore = false;
251:     if (mode === "mycoord" && (!scopeValue || !mcPick)) return;
252:     const cache = cacheRef.current;
253:     const key = tab === "snapshot" ? `snap|${dataVer}|${circle}|${metric}|${scopeParams}`
254:       : tab === "comprehensive" ? `comp|${dataVer}|${circle}|${scopeParams}`
255:       : tab === "datarev" ? `drev|${dataVer}|${circle}|${scopeParams}`
256:       : tab === "benchmark" ? `bench|${dataVer}|${circle}|${scopeParams}`
257:       : tab === "insight" ? `ins|${dataVer}|${circle}|${scopeParams}`
258:       : tab === "ftth" ? `ftth|${dataVer}|${circle}|${scopeParams}`
259:       : `prod|${dataVer}|${circle}|${pdScope}|${brand}`;
260: 
261:     const setFromData = (d: unknown) => {
262:       if (tab === "snapshot") setData(d as Snapshot);
263:       else if (tab === "comprehensive") setComp(d as Comprehensive);
264:       else if (tab === "datarev") setDrev(d as DataRev);
265:       else if (tab === "benchmark") setBench(d as Benchmark);
266:       else if (tab === "insight") setInsight(d as MarketInsight);
267:       else if (tab === "ftth") setFtthData(d as Comprehensive);
268:       else setProd(d as ProductDemand);
269:     };
270:     if (cache.has(key)) { setErr(""); setFromData(cache.get(key)); setLoading(false); return; }
271:     (async () => {
272:       setLoading(true); setErr("");
273:       try {
274:         let url = "";
275:         if (tab === "snapshot") url = `/api/reports/snapshot?metric=${metric}&circle=${encodeURIComponent(circle)}${scopeParams}`;
276:         else if (tab === "comprehensive") url = `/api/reports/comprehensive?circle=${encodeURIComponent(circle)}${scopeParams}`;
277:         else if (tab === "datarev") url = `/api/reports/data-revenue?circle=${encodeURIComponent(circle)}&brand=${brand}${scopeParams}`;
278:         else if (tab === "benchmark") url = `/api/reports/network-benchmark?circle=${encodeURIComponent(circle)}${scopeParams}`;
279:         else if (tab === "insight") url = `/api/reports/market-insight?circle=${encodeURIComponent(circle)}${scopeParams}`;
280:         else if (tab === "ftth") url = `/api/reports/ftth?circle=${encodeURIComponent(circle)}${scopeParams}`;
281:         else url = `/api/reports/product-demand?circle=${encodeURIComponent(circle)}&scope=${pdScope}&brand=${brand}`;
282:         const r = await authFetch(url); const d = await r.json();
283:         if (ignore) return;
284:         if (d.error) setErr(d.error); else { cache.set(key, d); setFromData(d); }
285:       } catch (e) { if (!ignore) setErr(String(e)); }
286:       if (!ignore) setLoading(false);
287:     })();
288:     return () => { ignore = true; };
289:   }, [tab, mode, mcPick, scopeValue, breakdownValue, metric, circle, brand, scopeParams, dataVer, reloadKey]);
290: 
291:   const load = useCallback(() => { cacheRef.current.clear(); authFetch("/api/reports/cache/clear", { method: "POST" }).catch(() => {}); setReloadKey((k) => k + 1); }, []);
292: 
293:   const disp = data?.display ?? { divisor: 1, unit: data?.metric.unit ?? "" };
294:   const up = (data?.totals.trend ?? "up") === "up";
295:   // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any
296:   const activeScope = (tab === "snapshot" ? data?.scope : tab === "comprehensive" ? comp?.scope : tab === "datarev" ? drev?.scope : tab === "benchmark" ? bench?.scope : tab === "insight" ? insight?.scope : tab === "ftth" ? ftthData?.scope : prod?.scope) as any;
297:   const monthLabel = activeScope?.month_id;
298:   const dataAsOf = activeScope?.data_as_of;
299: 
300:   return (
301:     <div style={{ minHeight: "100vh", background: IOH.panel, fontFamily: "Prompt, sans-serif", color: IOH.ink }}>
302:       <header style={{ background: IOH.white, borderBottom: `1px solid ${IOH.rule}`, padding: "14px 20px", display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: 12, position: "sticky", top: 0, zIndex: 10 }}>
303:         <button onClick={() => router.push("/")} style={btnGhost}>← Chat</button>
304:         <div style={{ fontFamily: "Poppins, sans-serif", fontWeight: 700, fontSize: 18 }}>Performance Outlook</div>
305:       </header>
306:       <div style={{ maxWidth: 1180, margin: "0 auto", padding: 20, paddingBottom: 80 }}>
307:         {/* mode tabs */}
308:         <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 6, overflowX: "auto", paddingBottom: 4, marginBottom: 12 }}>
309:           {([["mycoord", "◉", "My Coordinate"], ["territory", "▤", "Territory Wise"], ["snapshot", "◧", "Daily Snapshot"]] as const).map(([k, ic, lbl]) => (
310:             <button key={k} onClick={() => setMode(k)} style={{ ...iconTab, ...(mode === k ? iconTabActive : {}) }}><span style={{ fontSize: 15 }}>{ic}</span> <span style={{ fontSize: 12.5, fontWeight: 600 }}>{lbl}</span></button>
311:           ))}
312:         </div>
313:         {/* sub-tabs */}
314:         {mode !== "snapshot" && (
315:           <div style={{ ...seg, flexWrap: "nowrap", overflowX: "auto", maxWidth: "100%" }}>
316:             {([["comprehensive", "Comprehensive"], ["datarev", "Data Revenue"], ["product", "Product Demand"], ["benchmark", "Network Benchmark"], ["insight", "Market Insight"], ["ftth", "Indosat HiFi (FTTH)"]] as const).map(([k, lbl]) => (
317:               <button key={k} onClick={() => setSubTab(k)} style={{ ...segBtn, ...(subTab === k ? segBtnActive : {}) }}>{lbl}</button>
318:             ))}
319:           </div>
320:         )}
321:         {/* breakdown tabs (1 level below) */}
322:         {mode !== "snapshot" && CHILD_LEVEL[scopeType] && breakdownOptions.length > 0 && (
323:           <div style={{ ...seg, marginBottom: 12 }}>
324:             <button onClick={() => setBreakdownValue("Total")} style={{ ...segBtn, ...(breakdownValue === "Total" ? segBtnActive : {}) }}>Total ({scopeType === "all" ? circle : scopeValue})</button>
325:             {breakdownOptions.map((opt) => <button key={opt} onClick={() => setBreakdownValue(opt)} style={{ ...segBtn, ...(breakdownValue === opt ? segBtnActive : {}) }}>{opt}</button>)}
326:           </div>
327:         )}
328:         {/* info strip */}
329:         <div style={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", flexWrap: "wrap", gap: 10, marginBottom: showFilters ? 10 : 16 }}>
330:           {mode !== "mycoord" && (
331:             <button onClick={() => setShowFilters((v) => !v)} style={{ ...btnGhost, display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: 6 }}>
332:               <span>⚙</span> Filter {showFilters ? "▲" : "▼"}
333:               {scopeType !== "all" && scopeValue ? <span style={{ ...pill, padding: "1px 8px" }}>{scopeValue}</span> : null}
334:             </button>
335:           )}
336:           <div style={{ flex: 1 }} />
337:           {monthLabel && <span style={{ ...pill }}>Month {monthLabel}</span>}
338:           {dataAsOf && <span style={{ ...pill, background: "#EAF6F4", color: IOH.tealDeep, borderColor: "#CFE9E4" }}>Data as of {dataAsOf}</span>}
339:         </div>
340:         {/* my-coordinate locate */}
341:         {mode === "mycoord" && (
342:           <div style={{ background: IOH.white, border: `1px solid ${IOH.rule}`, borderRadius: 14, padding: 12, marginBottom: 16 }}>
343:             <div style={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: 10 }}>
344:               <button onClick={locateMe} style={{ ...btnPrimary }}>{loading && !mcLevels ? "Mencari lokasi…" : "◉ Gunakan Lokasi Saya"}</button>
345:               {geoErr && <span style={{ color: IOH.neg, fontSize: 12.5 }}>{geoErr}</span>}
346:             </div>
347:             {mcLevels && (
348:               <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 6, flexWrap: "nowrap", overflowX: "auto", marginTop: 10 }}>
349:                 {mcLevels.map((lv) => (
350:                   <button key={lv.level} onClick={() => pickLevel(lv)} style={{ ...chipBtn, flex: "0 0 auto", ...(mcPick === lv.level ? chipBtnActive : {}) }}>{lv.label}: {lv.name}</button>
351:                 ))}
352:               </div>
353:             )}
354:           </div>
355:         )}
356:         {/* filters */}
357:         {showFilters && mode !== "mycoord" && (
358:           <div style={{ background: IOH.white, border: `1px solid ${IOH.rule}`, borderRadius: 14, padding: 12, marginBottom: 16, display: "flex", alignItems: "flex-end", flexWrap: "wrap", gap: 10 }}>
359:             {tab === "snapshot" && (
360:               <label style={ctrlWrap}><span style={ctrlLbl}>Metric</span>
361:                 <select value={metric} onChange={(e) => setMetric(e.target.value)} style={{ ...select, minWidth: 170 }}>
362:                   {cats.map((c) => <optgroup key={c.name} label={c.name}>{c.metrics.map((m) => <option key={m.code} value={m.code}>{m.name}</option>)}</optgroup>)}
363:                 </select>
364:               </label>
365:             )}
366:             <label style={ctrlWrap}><span style={ctrlLbl}>Circle</span>
367:               <select value={circle} onChange={(e) => setCircle(e.target.value)} style={select}>
368:                 <option value="ALL">All Circles</option>
369:                 {CIRCLES.map((c) => <option key={c} value={c}>{c}</option>)}
370:               </select>
371:             </label>
372:             {mode === "territory" && (<>
373:               <label style={ctrlWrap}><span style={ctrlLbl}>View</span>
374:                 <select value={scopeType} onChange={(e) => { setScopeType(e.target.value); setScopeValue(""); setBreakdownValue("Total"); }} style={select}>
375:                   <option value="all">Circle</option>
376:                   {SCOPE_LEVELS.map((l) => <option key={l.key} value={l.key}>{l.label}</option>)}
377:                 </select>
378:               </label>
379:               {scopeType !== "all" && (
380:                 <label style={ctrlWrap}><span style={ctrlLbl}>{SCOPE_LEVELS.find((l) => l.key === scopeType)?.label}</span>
381:                   <select value={scopeValue} onChange={(e) => { setScopeValue(e.target.value); setBreakdownValue("Total"); }} style={{ ...select, minWidth: 160 }}>
382:                     <option value="">— pilih —</option>
383:                     {scopeOptions.map((v) => <option key={v} value={v}>{v}</option>)}
384:                   </select>
385:                 </label>
386:               )}
387:             </>)}
388:             <div style={{ flex: 1 }} />
389:             <button onClick={load} style={{ ...btnPrimary }}>↻</button>
390:           </div>
391:         )}
392:         {err && <div style={{ background: "#FDECEC", color: IOH.neg, padding: 12, borderRadius: 12, marginBottom: 16, fontSize: 13 }}>{err}</div>}
393:         {mode === "mycoord" && !scopeValue && !loading && <Panel title="My Coordinate"><div style={{ color: IOH.mute, fontSize: 13 }}>Tekan &quot;Gunakan Lokasi Saya&quot;, lalu pilih level wilayah.</div></Panel>}
394:         {loading && !data && !comp && !drev && !prod && !bench && !insight && <div style={{ padding: 40, textAlign: "center", color: IOH.mute }}>Memuat data…</div>}
395: 
396:         {/* ──── Snapshot ──── */}
397:         {tab === "snapshot" && data && (<>
398:           <div style={{ background: IOH.white, borderRadius: 16, borderTop: `3px solid ${BAND_BG[brand]}`, padding: 20, marginBottom: 16, boxShadow: "0 2px 10px rgba(15,31,29,.06)" }}>
399:             <div style={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", flexWrap: "wrap", gap: 12 }}>
400:               <div>
401:                 <div style={eyebrow}>{data.metric.name.toUpperCase()} · {brand.toUpperCase()} · MTD</div>
402:                 <div style={{ fontFamily: "Poppins, sans-serif", fontWeight: 700, fontSize: 34, lineHeight: 1.1, marginTop: 4 }}>
403:                   {fmtNum(brand === "ioh" ? data.totals.mtd : brand === "im3" ? data.totals.mtd_im3 : data.totals.mtd_3id, disp.divisor)} <span style={{ fontSize: 15, color: IOH.mute, fontWeight: 500 }}>{disp.unit}</span>
404:                 </div>
405:                 <div style={{ marginTop: 6, color: IOH.mute, fontSize: 13 }}>IOH {fmtNum(data.totals.mtd, disp.divisor)} · IM3 {fmtNum(data.totals.mtd_im3, disp.divisor)} · 3ID {fmtNum(data.totals.mtd_3id, disp.divisor)}</div>
406:               </div>
407:               <div style={{ textAlign: "right" }}>
408:                 <div style={{ fontFamily: "Poppins, sans-serif", fontWeight: 700, fontSize: 26, color: up ? IOH.pos : IOH.neg }}>{up ? "▲" : "▼"} {fmtPct(data.totals.pct_change)}</div>
409:                 <div style={{ color: up ? IOH.pos : IOH.neg, fontSize: 13, marginTop: 2 }}>{fmtVar(data.totals.abs_change, disp.divisor)} {disp.unit} vs LMTD</div>
410:               </div>
411:             </div>
412:           </div>
413:           <div style={{ display: "grid", gridTemplateColumns: "1fr 1fr", gap: 12, marginBottom: 16 }}>
414:             <Chip label="Best Branch" name={data.best?.name} v={data.best?.var} pct={data.best?.pct} divisor={disp.divisor} good />
415:             <Chip label="Worst Branch" name={data.worst?.name} v={data.worst?.var} pct={data.worst?.pct} divisor={disp.divisor} />
416:           </div>
417:           <Panel title={`Kecamatan Health Distribution · ${data.slabs.kecamatan.total} kecamatan`}><SlabBars s={data.slabs.kecamatan} /></Panel>
418:           {data.deck && <SnapshotDeck deck={data.deck} divisor={disp.divisor} />}
419:         </>)}
420: 
421:         {tab === "comprehensive" && comp && <ComprehensiveView comp={comp} brand={brand} />}
422:         {tab === "datarev" && drev && <DataRevView d={drev} brand={brand} />}
423:         {tab === "product" && prod && <ProductDemandView p={prod} brand={brand} />}
424:         {tab === "benchmark" && bench && <BenchmarkView b={bench} />}
425:         {tab === "insight" && insight && <MarketInsightView ins={insight} />}
426:         {tab === "ftth" && ftthData && <ComprehensiveView comp={ftthData} brand="ioh" />}
427:       </div>
428:       {/* sticky brand bar */}
429:       <div style={{ position: "sticky", bottom: 0, zIndex: 20, background: IOH.white, borderTop: `1px solid ${IOH.rule}`, padding: "8px 12px", display: "flex", justifyContent: "center", gap: 8, boxShadow: "0 -2px 10px rgba(15,31,29,.06)" }}>
430:         {([["ioh", "IOH"], ["im3", "IM3"], ["3id", "3ID"]] as const).map(([k, lbl]) => (
431:           <button key={k} onClick={() => setBrand(k as "ioh" | "im3" | "3id")}
432:             style={{ ...segBtn, padding: "8px 22px", border: `1px solid ${IOH.rule}`, ...(brand === k ? { background: k === "ioh" ? IOH.band_ioh : k === "im3" ? IOH.band_im3 : IOH.band_3id, color: k === "im3" ? "#161616" : "#fff", borderColor: "transparent" } : {}) }}>{lbl}</button>
433:         ))}
434:       </div>
435:     </div>
436:   );
437: }
438: 
439: /* ─── sub-components ─── */
440: function Panel({ title, children }: { title: string; children: React.ReactNode }) {
441:   return (<div style={{ background: IOH.white, borderRadius: 16, boxShadow: "0 2px 10px rgba(15,31,29,.05)", padding: 16, marginBottom: 16 }}><div style={{ ...eyebrow, marginBottom: 10 }}>{title}</div>{children}</div>);
442: }
443: function Chip({ label, name, v, pct, divisor, good }: { label: string; name?: string; v?: number; pct?: number; divisor: number; good?: boolean }) {
444:   const c = good ? IOH.pos : IOH.neg;
445:   return (<div style={{ background: IOH.white, borderRadius: 14, padding: "12px 16px", boxShadow: "0 1px 6px rgba(15,31,29,.05)", borderLeft: `4px solid ${c}` }}>
446:     <div style={eyebrow}>{label}</div>
447:     <div style={{ fontFamily: "Poppins, sans-serif", fontWeight: 700, fontSize: 16, marginTop: 2 }}>{name ?? "—"}</div>
448:     <div style={{ color: c, fontSize: 13, marginTop: 2 }}>{fmtVar(v, divisor)} · {fmtPct(pct)}</div>
449:   </div>);
450: }
451: function SlabBars({ s }: { s: Slabs }) {
452:   const buckets = [
453:     { k: "decline_gt5", lbl: "≤ -5%", color: "#B91C1C" }, { k: "decline_3_5", lbl: "-5..-3%", color: "#DC2626" },
454:     { k: "decline_1_3", lbl: "-3..-1%", color: "#EF4444" }, { k: "decline_0_1", lbl: "-1..0%", color: "#F87171" },
455:     { k: "growth_0_1", lbl: "0..1%", color: "#5EEAD4" }, { k: "growth_1_3", lbl: "1..3%", color: "#2DD4BF" },
456:     { k: "growth_3_5", lbl: "3..5%", color: "#14B8A6" }, { k: "growth_gt5", lbl: "≥ 5%", color: "#0E8579" },
457:   ] as { k: keyof Slabs; lbl: string; color: string }[];
458:   const max = Math.max(1, ...buckets.map((b) => s[b.k] as number));
459:   return (
460:     <div style={{ display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", gap: 5 }}>
461:       {buckets.map((b) => (
462:         <div key={b.k} style={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: 8, fontSize: 12 }}>
463:           <span style={{ width: 64, color: IOH.mute, textAlign: "right" }}>{b.lbl}</span>
464:           <div style={{ flex: 1, background: IOH.panel, borderRadius: 4, height: 16, overflow: "hidden" }}>
465:             <div style={{ width: `${((s[b.k] as number) / max) * 100}%`, background: b.color, height: "100%" }} />
466:           </div>
467:           <span style={{ width: 28 }}>{s[b.k] as number}</span>
468:         </div>
469:       ))}
470:     </div>
471:   );
472: }
473: function BrandTable({ rows, divisor }: { rows: Row[]; divisor: number }) {
474:   const bands = [
475:     { key: "ioh", label: "IOH", bg: IOH.band_ioh, fg: "#fff" },
476:     { key: "im3", label: "IM3", bg: IOH.band_im3, fg: "#161616" },
477:     { key: "3id", label: "3ID", bg: IOH.band_3id, fg: "#fff" },
478:   ] as const;
479:   const subs = ["LLMTD", "LMTD", "MTD", "Var", "%"];
480:   const sign = (v?: number | null) => ((v ?? 0) >= 0 ? IOH.pos : IOH.neg);
481:   return (
482:     <div style={{ overflowX: "auto" }}>
483:       <table style={{ borderCollapse: "collapse", width: "100%", fontSize: 12, minWidth: 760 }}>
484:         <thead><tr>
485:           <th rowSpan={2} style={{ ...th, textAlign: "left", position: "sticky", left: 0, zIndex: 3, background: IOH.white, minWidth: 130, boxShadow: `1px 0 0 ${IOH.rule}` }}>Name</th>
486:           {bands.map((b) => <th key={b.key} colSpan={5} style={{ ...th, background: b.bg, color: b.fg }}>{b.label}</th>)}
487:         </tr><tr>
488:           {bands.map((b) => subs.map((s) => <th key={b.key + s} style={{ ...th, background: b.bg, color: b.fg, fontWeight: 500, opacity: 0.9 }}>{s}</th>))}
489:         </tr></thead>
490:         <tbody>{rows.map((r, i) => {
491:           const cells = bands.map((b) => [
492:             fmtNum(r[`llmtd_${b.key}`] as number, divisor), fmtNum(r[`lmtd_${b.key}`] as number, divisor),
493:             <b key="m">{fmtNum(r[`mtd_${b.key}`] as number, divisor)}</b>,
494:             <span key="v" style={{ color: sign(r[`abs_growth_${b.key}`] as number) }}>{fmtVar(r[`abs_growth_${b.key}`] as number, divisor)}</span>,
495:             <span key="p" style={{ color: sign((b.key === "ioh" ? r["growth_pct"] : r[`growth_pct_${b.key}`]) as number) }}>{fmtPct((b.key === "ioh" ? r["growth_pct"] : r[`growth_pct_${b.key}`]) as number)}</span>,
496:           ]);
497:           const bg = i % 2 ? IOH.zebra : IOH.white;
498:           return (
499:             <tr key={i} style={{ background: bg }}>
500:               <td style={{ ...td, textAlign: "left", whiteSpace: "nowrap", fontWeight: 500, position: "sticky", left: 0, zIndex: 1, background: bg, boxShadow: `1px 0 0 ${IOH.rule}`, minWidth: 130 }}>
501:                 <div>{String(r.name)}</div>
502:                 {r.parent != null && <div style={{ fontSize: 10, color: IOH.mute }}>{String(r.parent)}</div>}
503:               </td>
504:               {cells.map((grp, bi) => grp.map((c, ci) => (
505:                 <td key={`${bi}-${ci}`} style={{ ...td, background: ci === 3 ? IOH.varTint : ci === 4 ? IOH.growTint : undefined }}>{c}</td>
506:               )))}
507:             </tr>
508:           );
509:         })}</tbody>
510:       </table>
511:     </div>
512:   );
513: }
514: function SnapshotDeck({ deck, divisor }: { deck: SnapDeck; divisor: number }) {
515:   const sections: [string, string][] = [["circle", "Circle"], ["region", "Region"], ["branch", "Branch"], ["microcluster", "Micro Cluster"], ["kabkota", "Kab/Kota"], ["kecamatan", "Kecamatan"]];
516:   const FULL = ["circle", "region", "branch"];
517:   const [sub, setSub] = useState("circle");

96:     else if (tab == 'ftth') _ftth = d;
97:     else _prod = d;
98:   }
99: 
100:   Future<void> _load({bool force = false}) async {
101:     // My Coordinate: wait until a located level is picked (scope set).
102:     if (_mode == 'mycoord' && _scopeValue.isEmpty) { setState(() => _loading = false); return; }
103:     final ft = (_scopeType != 'all' && _scopeValue.isNotEmpty) ? _scopeType : 'all';
104:     final fv = (_scopeType != 'all') ? _scopeValue : '';
105:     // snapshot/comprehensive payloads carry all brands → brand not in key.
106:     // _dataVer makes keys change when server data is refreshed.
107:     String keyFor() => _tab == 'snapshot' ? 'snap|$_dataVer|$_circle|$_metric|$ft|$fv'
108:         : _tab == 'comprehensive' ? 'comp|$_dataVer|$_circle|$ft|$fv'
109:         : _tab == 'datarev' ? 'drev|$_dataVer|$_circle|$_brand|$ft|$fv'
110:         : _tab == 'benchmark' ? 'bench|$_dataVer|$_circle|$ft|$fv'
111:         : _tab == 'insight' ? 'ins|$_dataVer|$_circle|$ft|$fv'
112:         : _tab == 'ftth' ? 'ftth|$_dataVer|$_circle|$ft|$fv'
113:         : 'prod|$_dataVer|$_circle|$_pdScope|$_brand';
114: 
115:     if (force) {
116:       _cache.clear();
117:       await _refreshDataVersion();
118:       // tell the server to rebuild fresh too
119:       try { await ApiClient.reportCacheClear(); } catch (_) {}
120:     }
121:     final key = keyFor();
122:     if (_cache.containsKey(key)) {
123:       setState(() { _error = null; _assign(_tab, _cache[key]!); _loading = false; });
124:       return;
125:     }
126: 
127:     setState(() { _loading = true; _error = null; });
128:     try {
129:       Map<String, dynamic> d;
130:       if (_tab == 'snapshot') {
131:         d = await ApiClient.reportSnapshot(metric: _metric, circle: _circle, filterType: ft, filterValue: fv);
132:       } else if (_tab == 'comprehensive') {
133:         d = await ApiClient.reportComprehensive(circle: _circle, filterType: ft, filterValue: fv);
134:       } else if (_tab == 'datarev') {
135:         d = await ApiClient.reportDataRevenue(circle: _circle, brand: _brand, filterType: ft, filterValue: fv);
136:       } else if (_tab == 'benchmark') {
137:         d = await ApiClient.reportNetworkBenchmark(circle: _circle, filterType: ft, filterValue: fv);
138:       } else if (_tab == 'insight') {
139:         d = await ApiClient.reportMarketInsight(circle: _circle, filterType: ft, filterValue: fv);
140:       } else if (_tab == 'ftth') {
141:         d = await ApiClient.reportFtth(circle: _circle, filterType: ft, filterValue: fv);
142:       } else {
143:         d = await ApiClient.reportProductDemand(circle: _circle, scope: _pdScope, brand: _brand);
144:       }
145:       if (!mounted) return;
146:       if (d['error'] != null) {
147:         setState(() => _error = d['error'].toString());
148:       } else {
149:         _cache[key] = d;
150:         setState(() => _assign(_tab, d));
151:       }
152:     } catch (e) {
153:       if (mounted) setState(() => _error = e.toString());
154:     }
155:     if (mounted) setState(() => _loading = false);
156:   }
157: 
158:   // ── number helpers ──
159:   double _div() => ((_data?['display']?['divisor']) as num?)?.toDouble() ?? 1;
160:   String _unit() => (_data?['display']?['unit'] ?? _data?['metric']?['unit'] ?? '').toString();
161: 
162:   String _fmt(dynamic v, {int dec = 1}) {
163:     if (v == null) return '—';
164:     final n = (v as num).toDouble() / _div();
165:     return NumberFormat('#,##0.${'0' * dec}', 'id').format(n);
166:   }
167: 
168:   String _pct(dynamic v) {
169:     if (v == null) return '—';
170:     final n = (v as num).toDouble();
171:     final s = n >= 0 ? '+' : '';
172:     return '$s${NumberFormat('#,##0.0', 'id').format(n)}%';
173:   }
174: 
175:   String _var(dynamic v) {
176:     if (v == null) return '—';
177:     final n = (v as num).toDouble();
178:     return '${n >= 0 ? '▲' : '▼'} ${_fmt(n.abs())}';
179:   }

375:   Future<void> _locateMe() async {
376:     setState(() { _loading = true; _geoErr = ''; _mcLevels = null; });
377:     final coord = await getCurrentCoord(context);
378:     if (coord == null) { if (mounted) setState(() => _loading = false); return; }
379:     try {
380:       final d = await ApiClient.reportLocate(lat: coord.$1, lon: coord.$2);
381:       if (!mounted) return;
382:       if (d['error'] != null) { setState(() { _geoErr = d['error'].toString(); _loading = false; }); }
383:       else {
384:         final lvls = ((d['levels'] as List?) ?? []).cast<Map<String, dynamic>>().where((x) => x['name'] != null).toList();
385:         setState(() {
386:           if (d['circle'] != null) _circle = d['circle'].toString();
387:           _mcLevels = lvls;
388:           if (lvls.isNotEmpty) { _mcPick = lvls.first['level'].toString(); _scopeType = _mcPick; _scopeValue = (lvls.first['value'] ?? lvls.first['name']).toString(); }
389:         });
390:         if (lvls.isNotEmpty) {
391:           // Load active tab data, then background-prefetch the rest
392:           await _prefetchAll();
393:         } else {
394:           if (mounted) setState(() => _loading = false);
395:         }
396:       }
397:     } catch (e) { if (mounted) setState(() { _geoErr = e.toString(); _loading = false; }); }
398:   }
399: 
400:   // Prefetch all 3 sub-reports for the current scope so tab switches are instant.
401:   Future<void> _prefetchAll() async {
402:     final ft = (_scopeType != 'all' && _scopeValue.isNotEmpty) ? _scopeType : 'all';
403:     final fv = (_scopeType != 'all') ? _scopeValue : '';
404:     // Fetch the active tab first (if it's not mycoord or snapshot)
405:     if (['comprehensive', 'datarev', 'product', 'benchmark', 'insight', 'ftth'].contains(_tab)) {
406:       setState(() { _loading = true; _error = null; });
407:       try {
408:         if (_tab == 'comprehensive') await _fetchAndCache('comp|$_dataVer|$_circle|$ft|$fv', () => ApiClient.reportComprehensive(circle: _circle, filterType: ft, filterValue: fv), 'comprehensive');
409:         else if (_tab == 'datarev') await _fetchAndCache('drev|$_dataVer|$_circle|$_brand|$ft|$fv', () => ApiClient.reportDataRevenue(circle: _circle, brand: _brand, filterType: ft, filterValue: fv), 'datarev');
410:         else if (_tab == 'product') await _fetchAndCache('prod|$_dataVer|$_circle|$_pdScope|$_brand', () => ApiClient.reportProductDemand(circle: _circle, scope: _pdScope, brand: _brand), 'product');
411:         else if (_tab == 'benchmark') await _fetchAndCache('bench|$_dataVer|$_circle|$ft|$fv', () => ApiClient.reportNetworkBenchmark(circle: _circle, filterType: ft, filterValue: fv), 'benchmark');
412:         else if (_tab == 'insight') await _fetchAndCache('ins|$_dataVer|$_circle|$ft|$fv', () => ApiClient.reportMarketInsight(circle: _circle, filterType: ft, filterValue: fv), 'insight');
413:         else if (_tab == 'ftth') await _fetchAndCache('ftth|$_dataVer|$_circle|$ft|$fv', () => ApiClient.reportFtth(circle: _circle, filterType: ft, filterValue: fv), 'ftth');
414:       } catch (_) {}
415:       if (mounted) setState(() => _loading = false);
416:     }
417:     
418:     // Background prefetch for others
419:     Future.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 500), () {
420:       if (!mounted) return;
421:       _fetchAndCache('comp|$_dataVer|$_circle|$ft|$fv', () => ApiClient.reportComprehensive(circle: _circle, filterType: ft, filterValue: fv), 'comprehensive');
422:       _fetchAndCache('drev|$_dataVer|$_circle|$_brand|$ft|$fv', () => ApiClient.reportDataRevenue(circle: _circle, brand: _brand, filterType: ft, filterValue: fv), 'datarev');
423:       _fetchAndCache('prod|$_dataVer|$_circle|$_pdScope|$_brand', () => ApiClient.reportProductDemand(circle: _circle, scope: _pdScope, brand: _brand), 'product');
424:       _fetchAndCache('bench|$_dataVer|$_circle|$ft|$fv', () => ApiClient.reportNetworkBenchmark(circle: _circle, filterType: ft, filterValue: fv), 'benchmark');
425:       _fetchAndCache('ins|$_dataVer|$_circle|$ft|$fv', () => ApiClient.reportMarketInsight(circle: _circle, filterType: ft, filterValue: fv), 'insight');
426:       _fetchAndCache('ftth|$_dataVer|$_circle|$ft|$fv', () => ApiClient.reportFtth(circle: _circle, filterType: ft, filterValue: fv), 'ftth');
427:     });
428:   }
429: 
430:   Future<void> _fetchAndCache(String key, Future<Map<String, dynamic>> Function() call, String tab) async {
431:     try {
432:       if (_cache.containsKey(key)) { _assign(tab, _cache[key]!); return; }
433:       final d = await call();
434:       if (d['error'] == null) { _cache[key] = d; _assign(tab, d); }
435:     } catch (_) {}
436:   }

506:   Widget _controls() {

520:             'microcluster': 'Micro Cluster', 'kabkota': 'Kab/Kota', 'kecamatan': 'Kecamatan',
521:           }, (v) {
522:             setState(() { _scopeType = v; _scopeValue = ''; });
523:             _loadScopeOptions();
524:             if (v == 'all') _load();
525:           }),
526:         if ((_tab == 'snapshot' || _tab == 'comprehensive' || _tab == 'datarev') && _scopeType != 'all')
527:           _wrapDrop(_scopeLabel(_scopeType), SizedBox(
528:             width: 190,
529:             child: DropdownButton<String>(
530:               value: _scopeValue.isEmpty ? null : _scopeValue,
531:               isExpanded: true,
532:               hint: const Text('— pilih —'),
533:               underline: const SizedBox.shrink(),
534:               items: _scopeOptions.map((v) => DropdownMenuItem(value: v, child: Text(v, overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis))).toList(),
535:               onChanged: (v) {
536:                 if (v == null) return;
537:                 setState(() => _scopeValue = v);

698:   Widget _slabBars(Map<String, dynamic>? s) {
699:     if (s == null) return const SizedBox.shrink();
700:     final buckets = [
701:       ['decline_gt5', '≤ -5%', const Color(0xFFB91C1C)],
702:       ['decline_3_5', '-5..-3%', const Color(0xFFDC2626)],
703:       ['decline_1_3', '-3..-1%', const Color(0xFFEF4444)],
704:       ['decline_0_1', '-1..0%', const Color(0xFFF87171)],
705:       ['growth_0_1', '0..1%', const Color(0xFF5EEAD4)],
706:       ['growth_1_3', '1..3%', const Color(0xFF2DD4BF)],
707:       ['growth_3_5', '3..5%', const Color(0xFF14B8A6)],
708:       ['growth_gt5', '≥ 5%', const Color(0xFF0E8579)],
709:     ];
710:     int maxv = 1;
711:     for (final b in buckets) {
712:       final v = (s[b[0]] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 0;
713:       if (v > maxv) maxv = v;
714:     }
715:     return Column(
716:       children: buckets.map((b) {
717:         final v = (s[b[0]] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 0;
718:         return Padding(
719:           padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 2.5),
720:           child: Row(children: [
721:             SizedBox(width: 56, child: Text(b[1] as String, textAlign: TextAlign.right, style: TextStyle(fontSize: 11, color: context.vMute))),
722:             const SizedBox(width: 8),
723:             Expanded(
724:               child: ClipRRect(
725:                 borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(4),
726:                 child: Container(
727:                   height: 16,
728:                   color: context.vPanel,
729:                   child: FractionallySizedBox(
730:                     alignment: Alignment.centerLeft,
731:                     widthFactor: maxv == 0 ? 0 : v / maxv,
732:                     child: Container(color: b[2] as Color),
733:                   ),
734:                 ),
735:               ),
736:             ),
737:             const SizedBox(width: 8),
738:             SizedBox(width: 26, child: Text('$v', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 11.5, color: context.vInk, fontFeatures: const [FontFeature.tabularFigures()]))),
739:           ]),
740:         );
741:       }).toList(),
742:     );
743:   }

745:   Widget _brandTable(dynamic rowsData) {
746:     final rows = (rowsData as List?)?.cast<Map<String, dynamic>>() ?? [];
747:     if (rows.isEmpty) return Text('Tidak ada data.', style: TextStyle(color: context.vMute));
748:     const bands = [
749:       ['ioh', 'IOH', Color(0xFF15A697), Colors.white],
750:       ['im3', 'IM3', Color(0xFFF5A623), Color(0xFF161616)],
751:       ['3id', '3ID', Color(0xFFEB008B), Colors.white],
752:     ];
753:     const subs = ['LLMTD', 'LMTD', 'MTD', 'Var', '%'];
754:     const nameW = 116.0, headH1 = 28.0, headH2 = 24.0, rowH = 42.0;
755:     Color signColor(num? v) => (v ?? 0) >= 0 ? IOH.teal600 : IOH.danger;
756: 
757:     Widget cell(String text, {Color? color, bool bold = false, Color? bg, double w = 76}) =>
758:         Container(
759:           width: w, height: rowH, alignment: Alignment.centerRight, color: bg,
760:           padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 6),
761:           child: Text(text, style: TextStyle(fontSize: 11.5, color: color ?? context.vInk, fontWeight: bold ? FontWeight.w700 : FontWeight.w400, fontFeatures: const [FontFeature.tabularFigures()])),
762:         );
763: 
764:     // Frozen Name column (header + body cells).
765:     final nameCol = Column(crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start, children: [
766:       Container(width: nameW, height: headH1, color: context.vWhite),
767:       Container(width: nameW, height: headH2, alignment: Alignment.centerLeft, padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8), child: Text('Name', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 11, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700, color: context.vMute))),
768:       for (var i = 0; i < rows.length; i++)
769:         Container(
770:           width: nameW, height: rowH,
771:           color: i.isOdd ? context.vZebra : context.vWhite,
772:           padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8),
773:           alignment: Alignment.centerLeft,
774:           child: Column(mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center, crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start, children: [
775:             Text((rows[i]['name'] ?? '').toString(), style: TextStyle(fontSize: 11, fontWeight: FontWeight.w500, color: context.vInk), maxLines: 1, overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis),
776:             if (rows[i]['parent'] != null) Text(rows[i]['parent'].toString(), style: TextStyle(fontSize: 9, color: context.vMute), maxLines: 1, overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis),
777:           ]),
778:         ),
779:     ]);
780: 
781:     // Scrollable data columns.
782:     final headRow1 = Row(children: [
783:       for (final b in bands)
784:         Container(width: 76 * 5, height: headH1, color: b[2] as Color, alignment: Alignment.center,
785:             child: Text(b[1] as String, style: TextStyle(color: b[3] as Color, fontFamily: 'Poppins', fontWeight: FontWeight.w700, fontSize: 12))),
786:     ]);
787:     final headRow2 = Row(children: [
788:       for (final b in bands)
789:         for (final s in subs)
790:           Container(width: 76, height: headH2, color: (b[2] as Color).withValues(alpha: 0.85), alignment: Alignment.centerRight, padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 6),
791:               child: Text(s, style: TextStyle(color: b[3] as Color, fontSize: 10))),
792:     ]);
793:     final body = <Widget>[];
794:     for (var i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
795:       final r = rows[i];
796:       final bg = i.isOdd ? context.vZebra : context.vWhite;
797:       final cells = <Widget>[];
798:       for (final b in bands) {
799:         final k = b[0] as String;
800:         final va = r['abs_growth_$k'] as num?;
801:         final pc = (k == 'ioh' ? r['growth_pct'] : r['growth_pct_$k']) as num?;
802:         cells.addAll([
803:           cell(_fmt(r['llmtd_$k']), bg: bg),
804:           cell(_fmt(r['lmtd_$k']), bg: bg),
805:           cell(_fmt(r['mtd_$k']), bold: true, bg: bg),
806:           cell(_var(va), color: signColor(va), bg: const Color(0xFFDAE5EE)),
807:           cell(_pct(pc), color: signColor(pc), bg: const Color(0xFFF2EAD2)),
808:         ]);
809:       }
810:       body.add(Row(children: cells));
811:     }
812: 
813:     return Row(crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start, children: [
814:       nameCol,
815:       Expanded(
816:         child: SingleChildScrollView(
817:           scrollDirection: Axis.horizontal,
818:           child: Column(crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start, children: [headRow1, headRow2, ...body]),
819:         ),
820:       ),
821:     ]);
822:   }

826:   String _fmtBy(String kind, dynamic v) {

830:     if (kind == 'pct') return '${NumberFormat('#,##0.0', 'id').format(n)}%';
831:     return _num(n);

837:     final nameCol = Column(crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start, children: [
838:       Container(width: nameW, height: headH, alignment: Alignment.centerLeft, padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8),
839:           child: Text('Metric', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 10, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700, color: context.vMute))),
840:       for (var i = 0; i < rowsDef.length; i++)
841:         Container(width: nameW, height: rowH, color: i.isOdd ? context.vZebra : context.vWhite,
842:             padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8), alignment: Alignment.centerLeft,
843:             child: Text(rowsDef[i][1], style: TextStyle(fontSize: 11, fontWeight: FontWeight.w500, color: context.vInk), maxLines: 1, overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis)),
844:     ]);
845:     Widget cell(String t, {bool head = false}) => Container(width: colW, height: head ? headH : rowH, alignment: Alignment.centerRight, padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 6),
846:         child: Text(t, style: TextStyle(fontSize: head ? 10 : 11, fontWeight: head ? FontWeight.w700 : FontWeight.w400, color: head ? context.vMute : context.vInk, fontFeatures: const [FontFeature.tabularFigures()])));
847:     final dataCols = Column(crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start, children: [
848:       Row(children: [for (final m in months) cell(m, head: true)]),
849:       for (var i = 0; i < rowsDef.length; i++)
850:         Container(color: i.isOdd ? context.vZebra : context.vWhite, child: Row(children: [
851:           for (final h in hist) cell(_fmtBy(rowsDef[i][2], h[rowsDef[i][0]])),
852:         ])),
853:     ]);
854:     return Row(crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start, children: [
855:       nameCol,
856:       Expanded(child: SingleChildScrollView(scrollDirection: Axis.horizontal, child: dataCols)),
857:     ]);

859:   List<Widget> _snapshotDeck() {
860:     final deck = _data!['deck'] as Map<String, dynamic>?;
861:     if (deck == null) return [];
862:     final counts = (deck['counts'] as Map<String, dynamic>?) ?? {};
863:     const sections = [
864:       ['circle', 'Circle'], ['region', 'Region'], ['branch', 'Branch'],
865:       ['microcluster', 'Micro Cluster'], ['kabkota', 'Kab/Kota'], ['kecamatan', 'Kecamatan'],
866:     ];
867:     const fullLevels = ['circle', 'region', 'branch'];
868: 
869:     // sub-tab selector
870:     final tabRow = SingleChildScrollView(
871:       scrollDirection: Axis.horizontal,
872:       child: Row(children: sections.map((s) {
873:         final active = _deckTab == s[0];
874:         return GestureDetector(
875:           onTap: () => setState(() => _deckTab = s[0]),
876:           child: Container(
877:             margin: const EdgeInsets.only(right: 6),
878:             padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 6, horizontal: 12),
879:             decoration: BoxDecoration(
880:               color: active ? IOH.teal500 : context.vWhite,
881:               borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(999),
882:               border: Border.all(color: active ? IOH.teal500 : context.vRule),
883:             ),
884:             child: Text(s[1], style: TextStyle(fontFamily: 'Poppins', fontSize: 12, fontWeight: FontWeight.w600, color: active ? Colors.white : context.vMute)),
885:           ),
886:         );
887:       }).toList()),
888:     );
889: 
890:     Widget content;
891:     final cnt = counts[_deckTab] ?? 0;
892:     if (fullLevels.contains(_deckTab)) {
893:       content = Column(crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start, children: [
894:         Text('Brand Breakdown · $cnt total', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 10.5, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700, color: IOH.teal600)),
895:         const SizedBox(height: 8),
896:         _brandTable((deck[_deckTab] as Map<String, dynamic>?)?['rows']),
897:       ]);
898:     } else {
899:       final set = deck[_deckTab] as Map<String, dynamic>?;
900:       content = Column(crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start, children: [
901:         Text('$cnt total', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 10.5, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700, color: IOH.teal600)),
902:         const SizedBox(height: 8),
903:         Text('▼ Top 10 Decline', style: TextStyle(fontFamily: 'Poppins', fontSize: 11, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700, color: IOH.danger)),
904:         const SizedBox(height: 6),
905:         _brandTable(set?['decline']),
906:         const SizedBox(height: 16),
907:         Text('▲ Top 10 Growth', style: TextStyle(fontFamily: 'Poppins', fontSize: 11, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700, color: IOH.teal600)),
908:         const SizedBox(height: 6),
909:         _brandTable(set?['growth']),
910:       ]);
911:     }
912: 
913:     return [
914:       _panel('Territory Breakdown', Column(crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start, children: [
915:         tabRow,
916:         const SizedBox(height: 12),
917:         content,
918:       ])),
919:     ];
920:   }

922:   // ── Comprehensive ──
923:   List<double> _scaleFor(double peak, String unit) {
924:     if (unit == 'GB' && peak >= 100000) return [1000, 0]; // [divisor, unitMode]
925:     if (peak >= 100000000) return [1000000, 1];
926:     if (peak >= 100000) return [1000, 2];
927:     return [1, 3];
928:   }
929: 
930:   String _fmtScaled(dynamic v, double divisor) {
931:     if (v == null) return '—';
932:     final n = (v as num).toDouble() / divisor;
933:     return NumberFormat('#,##0.0', 'id').format(n);
934:   }
935: 
936:   List<Widget> _comprehensiveSections([Map<String, dynamic>? payload]) {
937:     final src = payload ?? _comp;
938:     final sections = (src?['sections'] as List?)?.cast<Map<String, dynamic>>() ?? [];
939:     final out = <Widget>[];
940:     String? lastGroup;
941:     for (final s in sections) {
942:       final group = s['group'] as String?;
943:       if (group != null && group != lastGroup) {
944:         out.add(Padding(
945:           padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 6, bottom: 6),
946:           child: Text(group.toUpperCase(),
947:               style: TextStyle(fontFamily: 'Poppins', fontSize: 11, fontWeight: FontWeight.w800, color: context.vInk, letterSpacing: 0.6)),
948:         ));
949:       }
950:       lastGroup = group;
951:       if (s['layout'] == 'flat') {
952:         out.add(_panel('${s['title']}${s['month_used'] != null ? ' · ${s['month_used']}' : ''}', _flatTable(s)));
953:       } else {
954:         final cum = s['cumulative_yoy'] == true;
955:         out.add(_panel('${s['title']}${cum ? ' · YTD/YoY' : ''}', _compTable(s, cum)));
956:       }
957:       out.add(const SizedBox(height: 12));
958:     }
959:     return out;
960:   }
961: 
962:   Widget _flatTable(Map<String, dynamic> s) {
963:     final rows = (s['rows'] as List?)?.cast<Map<String, dynamic>>() ?? [];
964:     final columns = (s['columns'] as List?)?.cast<String>() ?? ['Share %'];
965:     String fmtCell(dynamic v, int ci) {
966:       if (v == null) return '—';
967:       final n = (v as num).toDouble();
968:       return ci == 0 ? '${NumberFormat('#,##0.0', 'id').format(n)}%' : NumberFormat('#,##0', 'id').format(n);
969:     }
970:     Widget cell(String t, {bool header = false, bool bold = false, double w = 90}) => SizedBox(
971:         width: w, child: Text(t, textAlign: TextAlign.right,
972:           style: TextStyle(fontSize: 11, fontWeight: bold ? FontWeight.w700 : FontWeight.w400,
973:             color: header ? context.vMute : context.vInk, fontFeatures: const [FontFeature.tabularFigures()])));
974:     return SingleChildScrollView(scrollDirection: Axis.horizontal, child: Column(crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start, children: [
975:       Row(children: [
976:         SizedBox(width: 90, child: Text('Operator', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 10.5, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700, color: context.vMute))),
977:         ...columns.map((c) => cell(c, header: true)),
978:       ]),
979:       ...rows.asMap().entries.map((e) {
980:         final r = e.value;
981:         final cells = (r['cells'] as List?) ?? [r['value']];
982:         final actor = (r['actor'] ?? '').toString();
983:         return Container(
984:           color: e.key.isOdd ? context.vZebra : context.vWhite,
985:           padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 7),
986:           child: Row(children: [
987:             SizedBox(width: 90, child: Text(actor, style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12, fontWeight: actor == 'IOH' || actor == 'Industry' ? FontWeight.w700 : FontWeight.w500, color: context.vInk))),
988:             ...columns.asMap().entries.map((ce) => cell(fmtCell(ce.key < cells.length ? cells[ce.key] : null, ce.key), bold: ce.key == 0)),
989:           ]),
990:         );
991:       }),
992:     ]));
993:   }
994: 
995:   Widget _compTable(Map<String, dynamic> s, bool cum) {
996:     final metrics = (s['metrics'] as List?)?.cast<Map<String, dynamic>>() ?? [];
997:     if (metrics.isEmpty) return Text('Tidak ada data.', style: TextStyle(color: context.vMute));

## Assistant (Plan · Agent-Java-v02.3 · 230.3s)

This is the key insight. The territory filtering is fundamentally broken because:

1. **`shp_kabkota`/`shp_kecamatan` are NULL** on the detail tables (the join columns the code uses) → join produces nothing.
2. The detail tables' real geography signal is **`sales_region`** (e.g. `04. Central Java`, `05. East Java`) and `province`/`city`. Sitewise uses **`region_25`** (same coded values).
3. The `rham_ref_territory.region` values are `BALI NUSRA / EAST JAVA / CENTRAL JAVA` — a **different vocabulary** from the FTTH `region_25`/`sales_region` codes (`04. Central Java`, `05. East Java`). So the existing join model (FTTH → ref_territory by region/area/branch) cannot work for the FTTH-native hierarchy.
4. Sitewise→territory by city+kecamatan only matches ~43% (213/499). Detail→territory by shp keys matches ~99% but shp keys are NULL in the live data sample (the 247 distinct were where non-null exist — but the bulk are NULL).

So FTTH has its **own** territory vocabulary (`sales_region`/`region_25` = numbered region codes; `province`; `city`; `kecamatan`) that does NOT align with the IM3 `rham_ref_territory` (circle/region/area/branch/kabkota/kec_id). The fix is to make FTTH territory filtering use FTTH-native columns rather than joining to `rham_ref_territory`.

## Assistant (Code · Agent-Java-v02.3 · 12.2s)

All three fixes are implemented, built, and live.

## 1. My Coordinate FTTH kecamatan now returns values
Root cause: My Coordinate sends the kecamatan as a `kec_id` (`ADIWERNA|KAB. TEGAL`), but the FTTH tables store the bare name (`ADIWERNA`), so the exact match found nothing. Added `_norm_kec()` in `reports_ftth.py` that strips the `|kabkota` suffix for `kecamatan`/`ftth_kecamatan` filters. Verified live: piped kecamatan now resolves (HP 1233, matching the direct filter).

## 2. Compact filter UI (mobile)
- Shrunk label font (10→8.5), field padding, corner radius, and dropdown text (now 12px, `isDense`, smaller caret/icons), fixed control heights to 30px, reduced wrap spacing and the filter container padding.

## 3. Searchable/typeable View value selector (web + mobile)
- **Mobile**: the scope-value field now opens a bottom-sheet picker (`_ScopeSearchSheet`) with an autofocused search box that filters the list as you type, with a result count and a check on the selected item, so no scrolling through 187 kecamatan.
- **Web**: replaced the `<select>` with a typeable `<input list>` + `<datalist>` giving native autocomplete suggestions. The data fetch is gated so partial keystrokes don't fire invalid backend queries (only fires once the typed value matches a real option).

## Deployment
- Backend restarted; web rebuilt and `telco-frontend` restarted (`/reports` → 200).
- APK bumped to **1.43.1+49**, built, and copied to `Bizplan-Java-Agent.apk`; `app_release.json` notes updated. `flutter analyze` shows only pre-existing infos (no errors from new code). No em-dashes added.

The web changes are live now; mobile users get the fixes after updating to 1.43.1.

## Summary
Added the new FTTH subscriber table to the AI agent's knowledge base (`backend/data/knowledge_base.json`):

- **New table** `rham_ftth_sitewise_monthly` under the `ftth` domain with all 33 columns documented in Indonesian, including the key subscriber/capacity fields: `pa` (cumulative active subscribers), `homepass`, `available_hp`, `ga` (gross add), `pa_net_latest` (net add), `region_25`, `project_awal` (footprint), and `brand` (Orbit/Non Orbit). Facts: ~166K rows, month_id 202312..202606 (STRING).
- **`table_count`** for the `ftth` domain bumped 3 → 4.
- **Enriched the FTTH agent** persona + key_facts to teach the two grains (per-customer funnel detail vs. per-site monthly subscriber snapshot), the rule that `pa` is a cumulative snapshot (use `MAX(month_id)`, never sum across months), the TUR formula, footprint mapping, and that FTTH `region_25` differs from IM3 territory.
- Created a `.bak` backup of the original, validated the JSON, and restarted `telco-backend` (the loader is `lru_cache`d so a restart is required to pick up changes).

Now I see the issue clearly. In `reports_comprehensive.py`:

- **YTD (flow):** `r_ytd_flow` = SUM of `_MTH` (full closed months) for `prior_months` (Jan..current-1) **plus** current `mtd` (from `_MTD` table, capped at cutoff day). This IS the mix the user wants. ✓

This is the bug — it uses the **full** prior-year current month from `_MTH`, not the MTD-capped equivalent. So YTD includes a partial current month (MTD) while LYTD includes a full current month → **not apple-to-apple**.

The fix: LYTD should be `SUM(_MTH for Jan..(current_month-1) last year) + MTD-equivalent of (current month last year)`. The current-month-last-year MTD comes from the `_MTD` table at `month_id = mid - 100` (the `_MTD` table is itself MTD-capped at the same cutoff day, mirroring how current-year MTD works).

## Assistant (Code · Agent-Java-v02.3 · 14.0s)

Done. I fixed the YTD/LYTD apple-to-apple logic across all reports.

## The bug
YTD correctly mixed full closed months + a **partial** current month (MTD, capped at the data cutoff day), but **LYTD** summed full closed months for the *entire* Jan..current-month last year — including a **full** prior-year current month. So YTD's partial June 2026 was being compared against a full June 2025. For `rev_prepaid` this overstated LYTD by ~1.72 trillion (21.24T instead of the correct 19.52T).

## The fix
Made LYTD mirror YTD exactly:
- **YTD** = `SUM(_mth: Jan..current-1 this year)` + `MTD(current month this year)`
- **LYTD** = `SUM(_mth: Jan..current-1 last year)` + `MTD(current month last year)` — where the prior-year current month now comes from the **cutoff-capped MTD table** (same day-of-month window), not the full-month table.

Verified the prior-year MTD snapshot is symmetric (June 2025 snapshot = day 16, same as June 2026 = day 16).

## Files changed
- **`reports_comprehensive.py`** (drives Comprehensive + Profile Analysis): split LYTD into prior-LY full months (`_mth`) + current-LY MTD (`_mtd[mid-100]`).
- **`reports_data.py`** (Data Revenue + Product Demand): same fix in all 4 cumulative blocks — channel chunks, price slabs, product-demand slabs, and top products — using `_channel`/`_slab`/`_product` MTD tables for the current-LY month.
- **`reports_ftth.py`** (Indosat HiFi): rewrote the LYTD date window to `[(year-1)-01-01 .. cur_dt minus 1 year]` via `DATE_SUB`, fixing a January edge-case and making it symmetric with YTD.

## Validation (live)
- Comprehensive `rev_prepaid`: LYTD now **19,517,981,810,937** = exactly `Jan–May 2025 (_mth) + Jun 2025 MTD (_mtd)`; no longer the buggy 21.24T. ✅
- Data Revenue: YTD 20.77T vs LYTD 18.11T (+14.7% YoY), both partial-June. ✅
- FTTH SO: YTD 58,959 vs LYTD 39,563. `ftth_pa` LYTD=0 is correct (PA data only began Nov 2025, so the Jan–Jun 2025 window is genuinely empty). ✅

Backend restarted; cache cleared via `refresh=true` during validation so the corrected values are live.

9: ```
10: 
11: The three are separate git repos / loosely coupled; there is no root workspace manifest. Work in one component at a time.
12: 
13: ## Backend
14: 
15: ### Setup & run
16: 
17: ```bash
18: cd backend
19: python -m venv venv && source venv/bin/activate
20: pip install -r requirements.txt
21: uvicorn app.main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000
22: ```
23: 
24: `python`/`pip` are only available inside the venv — activate it before running anything.
25: 
26: ### requirements.txt is INCOMPLETE
27: 
28: `requirements.txt` lists only fastapi/uvicorn/bigquery/pydantic. The app also imports, at runtime, packages that are NOT declared: `python-jose` (`jose`), `passlib`, `sqlalchemy`, `openpyxl`, `reportlab`, `pyshp` (`shapefile`), `shapely`, `requests`. Many are imported lazily inside functions, so the server starts fine and only fails when you hit the relevant endpoint (auth, export, geo). If you add a feature, install the dep and add it here.
29: 
30: ### Environment
31: 
32: `config.py` parses `backend/.env` itself (no python-dotenv) and provides defaults for everything, so missing vars fail silently with possibly-wrong defaults rather than erroring. Keys:
33: - LLM: `LLM_BASE`, `LLM_KEY`, plus per-role models `LLM_MODEL`, `LLM_MODEL_FAST`, `LLM_MODEL_SQL`, `LLM_MODEL_CODER`, `LLM_MODEL_ANALYST`. `LLM_OMIT_TEMPERATURE` defaults true.
34: - BigQuery: `BQ_PROJECT`, `BQ_DATASET`, `BQ_LOCATION`, and `BQ_ADC` (path to ADC json; default is a hardcoded `~/.config/gcloud/...` path — override it).
35: - DB: `TELCO_AI_DB` (SQLite file, default `backend/data/telco_ai.db`).
36: - Geo: `KEC_SHP_PATH` (default `/home/ubuntu/telco-ai/shp/Data Kecamatan Indonesia`).
37: 
38: ### Architecture (not obvious from filenames)
39: 
40: `main.py` is one large file; `/api/chat/stream` (SSE) is the core and contains the full pipeline inline as a generator. Flow: Router → Analyst → Domain scope gate (can reroute/clarify/out-of-scope) → SQL write with error-retry + self-critique refine loop → Synthesizer. It branches into special modes by `domain`:
41: - `PROFILE` → `profile_engine.py` fans out parallel multi-domain queries into a deck.
42: - `CORRELATE` → `correlate_agent.py` joins two domains on a territory key.
43: - advisory follow-ups → `advisor_agent.py` reasons over already-fetched data (stored via `memory.store_context`) instead of re-querying.
44: - `map_context=True` → `map_synth_agent.py` (map render spec + narration); skips the scope gate and critique loop.
45: 
46: Other agents/modules: `orchestrator.py` (route/write_sql/critique), `analyst_agent.py`, `geo_locate.py` (GPS→kecamatan via SHP, then nearest sites/outlets), `knowledge.py` (loads `data/knowledge_base.json`), `bigquery_tool.py` (read-only, byte-capped), `export_agent.py` (XLSX/PDF), `memory.py` (short-term + analytics + learnings), `database.py`/`auth.py`/`routes_auth.py` (JWT auth, users, chat history persistence, usage logs).
47: 
48: Auth is optional on chat: a request with no token stays anonymous; an EXPIRED token returns 401 (so mobile refreshes) rather than saving as anonymous. JWT `sub` is the username — resolve to user PK via the `User` table, never `int(sub)`.
49: 
50: ### Geo / choropleth build step
51: 
52: Map polygons are pre-built, not generated on the fly. `python build_geojson.py` reads the kecamatan SHP and writes gzipped `data/geo/{kecamatan,kabupaten}.geojson.gz` + `territory_map.json`. The `/api/geo/shapes/*` endpoints only serve gzip when the client sends `Accept-Encoding: gzip` — this is deliberate to avoid a proxy double-gzip bug; don't "simplify" it to always-gzip.
53: 
54: ### Knowledge base
55: 
56: `backend/data/knowledge_base.json` defines domains (site performance, network, market share, forecast, HVC, marketing, sales, fixed broadband, geography, KPI, reports), BigQuery table schemas, and SQL-generation prompts. Edit this to add domains/tables rather than hardcoding in agents.
57: 
58: No Python linter, formatter, or unit test suite. Root-level `test_batch.py` / `rerun_failures.py` / `test_pipeline.py` are integration scripts that POST real questions to a running `localhost:8000`; they need the server + BigQuery live.
59:

72: - `@/*` → `./src/*`. App Router pages live in `src/app/` (`map/`, `profile/`, `admin/`, `login/`).
